Friends,
Michiganders are excited about the prospect of our senator possibly emerging as a 'dark-horse' VP pick for President Harris's administration.

I'm running for Congress in Michigan's 1st District, Up North - in the UP and Northern Michigan.
It would be an honor to share a down-ballot spot with Kamala Harris and her vice presidential pick this November. She has my endorsement.
I'm with her.

I'm Bob Lorinser, and I've been working tirelessly to to unseat MAGA extremist, Trump-endorsed, Rep. Jack Bergman for 35 months, and we're gaining some serious ground.

Vice President Harris and I share the same priorities including affordable child care, education, and housing, along with building up the middle class.

They will grow up knowing that a woman of color, just like them, can accomplish anything, even becoming the leader of the free world.

So, let’s talk about it.
Because of President Donald Trump’s successful policies, our border was secure, and we had the lowest levels of illegal border crossings in a generation. Enter Kamala Harris. In her words, _“the [Harris-Biden] administration’s immigration policies largely involve undoing the previous one’s work.”_
So, what was the result of the Harris-Biden administration undoing President Trump’s policies? [Under Kamala Harris](https://email.join.djtfp24.com/c/eJxckU2PmzAQhn_NcCMyY2PsA4e0iF52paiHqntCjj0kRuZDwZSyv74iQT3s9X3H4-exTT8F324lFN8A8e7dDIjAz4D4-3J9__xB2_WShtu5S93l4y1_22v8Dohxm-j_7LHmRL3xYU-LKnEltyK31CZUZgViLvO8wOReSm3RCtNibrlRgmdGWeIary0ZV7Qi8SUyFEwxZIiSiRNZQoVOOS1YzjSBYN3oh5PrYjuhONmxT0J5j3Ganzw1YL2u68mNgwmui4-ln_YhwHqgdQasjbFacaVTaZVKhWVZqgtnUqk1l5wXhvEMeL3EvunJ-aUHXh1ycg_ncXlYAl4NNjSH_VFZ00_G3wbg1UsiPTCb_e5AMdKjYYplze5wdE-41_FxiDTE1-r0rxWf5-v2k3JA2QzBO-DVl_D5a7wSvzq3nN-3jy15lG5afQh-lgUIdtvBn4_0p8R_AQAA___OoZsI):
* 9.9 million illegal immigrants have crossed the border.

* Roughly 31 tons of fentanyl have crossed the southern border, enough to kill roughly 14.1 billion people. Experts say only 5 to 10 percent of the drugs crossing the border are being intercepted.
* Fentanyl is now the leading cause of death for Americans aged 18 to 45. There were 112,000 fatal drug overdoses in 2023, a new record high.

“Border Czar” Harris has only visited the border once as vice president – traveling to a politically-friendly district rather than the epicenter of the crisis – and that was years ago. President Trump [went to witness](https://link.mail.donaldjtrump.?utm_medium=email&utm_source=ncl_amplify&utm_campaign=240802-djtfp24_newsletter_0801_joindjtfp24com&utm_content=ncl-UYP425E3np&_nlid=UYP425E3np&_nhids=4VjduAMyYy) the crisis firsthand just a few months ago and has been numerous times during his administration and after.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The Connection Between Faith and Freedom
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi8ajesesg3743enldok8mh8084h55sgsgcopd2g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2clie4o70sdh2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfqnvl17go11j24i6t3tp9kdhf6hvri82jrekm6o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2clie4o70sdh2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z57996to5ikuc43jpudn8adppehfktvh92pc18l0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2clie4o70sdh2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| 1600 Daily

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: National Referendum on Religious Liberty
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhiv0pot6sktsnglagifjc9ecojgdmc4mtpnv4k0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2clie2or6cph2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zplv4anm45lpucuoj38oa31klnafqgdvqch0r2jo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2clie2or6cph2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z37rs7rdjimfgdjj76pt0flout7emgi36qcsvgjo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2clie2or6cph2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d2c3ab2e79e4d159de1088c5d4f5348&_e=QDcqnbe1Q2aERmbd6eoftxRgTpkBrGgzgJ9tp0BZmBLuG35qGwPQPvdOy4DNQH0Bi-PabwVAf8oqQZ8076nnuuouaajJLB94yhScinojyc7wwENJY4vXYhoC4_2WhyipIt5Vt4uzxArreJ6b4Y-_-eK0jX6LQazgfqKEQNirW7Y-GRXUwcvNhMV07fmLkxvtWMQ9qrGqdf97a16n2z0nuphzhf63yVvmCLnfPHLTdJS8xN2Jc57SGtk2f0OW5uXe1Ec78OzoNw0fys4bQ1dYkMysiuqA7dS9lQcKi0JeA7SknzG0tP3HU-SfrRg_qNmT6rt52z747Aux7hjZE8udDncUgIA5NDkWOdH25AwFu_GK69Dix2ShvR8XG0A3wT1LqP506NtknP6Q8k-Sa6n_4Q%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d2c3ab2e79e4d159de1088c5d4f5348&_e=QDcqnbe1Q2aERmbd6eoftxRgTpkBrGgzgJ9tp0BZmBLuG35qGwPQPvdOy4DNQH0Bi-PabwVAf8oqQZ8076nnuuouaajJLB94yhScinojyc7wwENJY4vXYhoC4_2WhyipIt5Vt4uzxArreJ6b4Y-_-eK0jX6LQazgfqKEQNirW7Y-GRXUwcvNhMV07fmLkxvtWMQ9qrGqdf97a16n2z0nuphzhf63yVvmCLnfPHLTdJS8xN2Jc57SGtk2f0OW5uXe50VI5bQen7MX1A0NNLW3aWAnvXwbSfIIX6X4VAonMsvjBQXK54msrrxEcjyecW3x1r__WcCtqUcBft19Nljz2NaM1WcwDPaiGOz1hjqUemMVhwX8LkhkrshQsJcezf8TanKnCW-E5qcxIGSz_gBxUg%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d2c3ab2e79e4d159de1088c5d4f5348&_e=QDcqnbe1Q2aERmbd6eoftxRgTpkBrGgzgJ9tp0BZmBLuG35qGwPQPvdOy4DNQH0Bi-PabwVAf8oqQZ8076nnuuouaajJLB94yhScinojyc7wwENJY4vXYhoC4_2WhyipIt5Vt4uzxArreJ6b4Y-_-eK0jX6LQazgfqKEQNirW7Y-GRXUwcvNhMV07fmLkxvtWMQ9qrGqdf97a16n2z0nuphzhf63yVvmCLnfPHLTdJS8xN2Jc57SGtk2f0OW5uXe4h1ndUL2438F41WSvNHJcQb5VzZ0OJbNKiKldmfNMYVYi7f1IX_Rq9AQCtLUiY5HPNdxckSNTvEu1peQOJI6HTLfb0UaAvJxgvJ4gajpdTi3AOTn9WLF1JN2iyDwwjko1zgFyfYdc8hcZd5XvTuW1g%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Hillsdale College via Conservatives Give
subject: Has American turned away from the Constitution?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9d23fa973cff43d895cb2c794576ad31&_e=Y9H1rqkR7_W0-OlwezIugbazgJOVzK_QXrSHOWwOtKKVqYYU9PgyzIKoeMrlGylqaFigySNaxoj4a8x1O7k3dfVvy8iCY7PKXSAPT48J30MkSYspwa0BpwYYCZqWOQnlMOLdiE_Oxabqeh81ICcA8V0abEqsBD3RLqEjkiZ9qZCdHO096lGyWBpkIvVIZ6nmZCiObzEgIGWhVWgxzu94Zb-oFzS8rbwYhb-jHpFttYaW1BDHkTHiezbu3BL2DYSrzSphIUQzmgo9GWR7a296KBVTOqo4lp5fiu6myuYhvakw8P7JSA09AmvZWlj2ZdR48DlX7nClg0jZis-hxiTEQGAP3I8kbgG3w18KfxiB5REHNyrcQoZzvW6C2guU10CgiQiDJw46k6L5aPtHx4VeIw%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."

The U.S., Western allies, and Russia [exchanged 24 prisoners](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFv8yAQgOFfA5sjfAbjDAzfwpZv7Whd8BFfhcECmij_vmrnzq_0Ds_Hbb0hJ86P_3iQ67GsGDo_aV0GGECvWm4uEgFNktxoAWZlJmvk7iyMQQe6T3FZNN7jaEMwBDRbY4MNVrIDBVotCkallNEXc73qeSNckK6INgqtaONe6uWzcO47xfQuT6qXUA6Z3N772cT0T4AX4PtOO6f00wT4syQObwF-o0i5kQCvFzVPsxnqV2uMecCDKgfMw1m5lUx1aC88BXhZ3Xa-OCVusxVaPQ7k36_sfwI8HXwHAAD__9tTXeA) in Turkey on Thursday in the largest exchange of detainees since the Cold War.Wall Street Journal [reporter Evan Gershkovich](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGupCAUQL8GOwxeQbSg2MZutt3S3JHLyC6CAUayf_8yr37dSU5zcv48tgf64OPrN55kqksb7tXftM0cOMhNdtY4IqCxIzNogEmoUavuMItUo11GZ3fh4PmUiganQY1WD07PNHXegAApZgGDEELJXi2LnCzhjLQgasekIOtryv3f5GM9yIX_6abc7-nsgjlqvQobfzFYGayttX5_lkitfDyD9YMM1nfh-V2KR35lX1KkzEvDi7tMVDielP2OsXC6MfIX5XL8S7ffD37hO_B2UMDIYO2ysVfzIfgyaSbF60Qfvkvqj1tuA18BAAD__wx0Z8I), former U.S. Marine Paul Whelan, and Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty journalist Alsu Kurmasheva were among those exchanged for eight Russian prisoners, including Vadim Krasikov, a Russian assassin held in Germany.The prisoner swap [was the result of months-long](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtuwzAMAL_G3hxQ1NODhi7Z0rWjwUh0zFaxA0t10L8v0rnj4YYD7uMyXUiKrLd3unNs8zZRanLwFAYc0Eymz3FmRtY9R-URHVjtbb_ErIjNNVwV-ZECZueTB6uUg-xZ69xLREADAVABgDUnO47GZaZAPBL5uTPAWdq2nz43WdvCc_nZDt5Pabv3JS6tPWqn3zo8d3imx8rP-lIv2Jukwh2e9-9ahYYb73X52g5Jy_BcuNA65ACa0bl0NexAacvJZudCdsFYHOd-j_nxlFKkOt8ZuN1Jyl-6_fvhiPgbAAD__-yOXmU) negotiations involving the U.S., Turkey, Germany, Russia, Poland, Slovenia, Norway, and Belarus. The deal required concessions from European allies, including the release of the Russian hitman.The complete list of prisoners exchanged freed 12 German and Russian activists and four U.S. detainees from a Russian prison in return for the West sending eight Russian prisoners back to Moscow.

## Texas Juvenile Prisons Blasted By DOJ
The U.S. Department of Justice released a 73-page report on Thursday accusing the Texas Juvenile Justice Department of [violating the civil and constitutional rights](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL2SnDAQhJ9GZNoSw8-ygQInys6pQ0qMRsectdIWGuD89i42vqSjrq9__nzMH54T58_f_klWvmOZPQofNE8aNPRz3wS7mPBoG7LtHWA0LTyGZrXDiBQ94TSZ3rSLGeNEyyN0fRcXRNM1bMFAbyYDrRnGztw8YMTJ3KkLj3YAVL2hwFK2m6wk9O1rTP_KQdsNy7NJdhV5VdX9UuAUuPM8b5gY_8Ja9iolXy4FLtNZFbhU0CcF7spU4Mx0SavAef3yIrRlXaL2y15JY8mBhUuuOpZN48opbJS1Fz3odxH9tR-UOZH-2qswko4eObEwVX1wSV7emCos-0VS4JrNhtfJKXEd76o3n0_P6T1Ffj72sPA_AAD__ySDffo) of children detained in their five facilities across the state. The report details how children are [routinely subjected](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOwyAQBb8Gd1jLGhu7oLjGXa690iKwJBsRExli5_7-lNTXveKNRvNzWk6OE6-Xb3cnW18xL85X3mkZJUrUi26CPUOYVENWGcQBFE59c7XR9L0K46TNAGc36uA6rcGo6Px0dqZr2CKghhFQQT900Dr00Y9gqAuT6tELDRS45q2tV6r0ciWm37zT1vp8b5K91vooovsSOAucj-NoY37plY7yPgic31PgHPJNfnB5e-60ciJ5e5bKnqSntdImd87JVc5raTYbHgenxGUwQsPl7jh9fPX_-t3iXwAAAP__E25eoQ) to isolation, excessive force, and sexual abuse while being denied access to special education or mental health treatment. The U.S. Attorney General's Office began an investigation into Texas' juvenile detention centers in 2021, visiting facilities and [interviewing hundreds of children](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu6zAQRL-G6igsVy-qYHEbdb5tSoGPpUWHEg2Rlpy_D-ykTDlzgAHmfFzmiw4xbNf_eiVVnj7N2pZw0Cw5cmzntnLKgBtFRUoMiD0IHLtqUdaANY03ZKWRQyeoHztwznoPZMFAFRQCtiABBXR9A7VG662EgRo3ig4ta4FcKGmvy0KFnjr7-JUO2mub1iqqpZR7Zs0_hhPD6TzP-vN40AsynPRego3EcNrozAynXHR5xfcQ_y21eWTiOka66hLSlvkPvj0O2kIk7rUNMZRAme90T3vhfk8rLwtxl24MJ-xH7sB1xnrBGxSSt9Q33HiUXHS-Gd1ghSVZ7crdzxBjyP3AWriuOsT3kfK31kPhdwAAAP__FoF7cw), staff, teachers, and clinicians. The agency did not announce any enforcement actions against the state but recommended a series of changes to improve conditions in the facilities.
## Low-Income Texans Could Get Free Home
Several Central Texas cities, including Waco and Belton, are participating in a [federally funded program](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2OpDAQBOCngcyjpjFgAgeXkO2lF45Mu5lpnX9Gtg923_40G29WUkmfVPXn4_7hJEh6_HaRbfs88t1Rk5PvRqFCfde9tzv4dejZDgviDAOuU_-0jkHvuzakZ304QnADLEieJz6QzNKLRUANBnCAaR7h5pAOMrDw6NdhQuo0sJeWy609ufGnq0f4yieXG-XYB_ts7VW78VeHW4fbdV23v8Spne-6w82VJhS4wy3xVTvcKMf4L0n7emdOrbigvllF0oSrKkwsp6SHeubI6lXyo7ioXK1Sm0vEKuRLSaIc3-wEoBaYYQT0avYrKr0ar9Z9RWUAcFx2N2rDfbH-dUkIUuel0_CITsL3hvbzo6fF_wEAAP__5jB4cA) that could provide low-income families with a brand new home. The federally funded [HOME Investment Partnerships Program](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxszzGPtCAQgOFfg51mGHFXC4qvsduvvdIAjkICYmCie__-ks2V1z_Jm_frtbxMiOHY_5tEmt9bXozjcNEyttiiWlSzagvrJBvS8on4AInT0Hi9TdIaayalpLRgabM9gFPODnIce0lN0AioYASUMDx66Ay6zY3wpH6d5IBOKKA1cC4de2J6m7rF73xR6VxOTdSe-ayi_ydwFjjf993x6p3pPrTb8yVwPkvei0lV4OxzojYcF1VOdHB7msIHlerDWdtf1xS9nneIMdTHUyjYkwnxk-O_5y-NPwEAAP__QwdfGw) aims to replace substandard housing with new builds--typically with three bedrooms and two bathrooms--on the same lots. Applicants must prove they own their property and don't have any liens on it, and their income must be between 30 and 80 percent of the median income in their area. If approved for a new home, they must agree to live there for [at least five years](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OwyAQhJ8Gd2vB-r-guMZdrr3S2sASI2GIbGKStz8luvK6Gc1oNPp-LsuFfPDx9k0b6_x0aSGT_cnLCAjYLm1l9VXaSVWs1YDYS4VTV62aEKmjK0-qaQgtjeOEbAc1SiYl-77yGiW2cpSoZNc3siY0zoxy4MZOqkMjWsnW57TXeeXMTzpceKWT99qkrQp6zfl-iOZL4CxwLqXULj3bNnI53g2B81sKnEMyFODPXDkEMOkR8-sTFfDRpI3B0eaD5wNiKrDSyUBgVoqGISdIJQK9N2BNj4PBpR3czixwrnZt78WH4I9-EK28beTD52P-n9ip8TcAAP__8kNv0Q) before selling the property.
## Texas Among Youngest U.S. States
Texas is currently the fourth-youngest state in the U.S., according to BizInsure's "[Aging in America](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FugzAQgOGnMRvoOBwDg4cubOnaETnnMznJhAhfIe3TV-3c_dcvfR_X-Roky2N5Dyt7faVtDqRy8DzUWKOdbRX9DeLYVuzbHtFBi-OlunuHZMlSH-lmk-3IDTFGsqPDlACGVIlHQAsDYAsX10ETkBIN0HMXx_aCZCxwFN32Ru-s_Aol5a_t4L2hba2yv6s-i-neDE4Gp_M8m5t8y6N87vxbGJzCyrtQKHUKRbloHRZ5LHXRoFwMTtXu4_OUnKW43lhY1iD5767_Ww-PPwEAAP__ILhYQA)" report. Despite an expected increase in its senior population, [Texas is projected](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OwyAQhJ8Gd0TL-r-guMZdrr3SwmaxkTBEsHGStz8l0nXXjmY0n76f63w1Pvi4fZuDND9dms3K_qR5kCixmZvK6gXsqCrSqkfsQOHYVrt2PSKBHWhZ2tZR60araurILaa2iG3lNQI2MAAqaLsaLgZXtw7QU21H1eIqGiDrOeUL78T0NMWFVzopX9Z0VEHvzLci6i-Bk8CpmGjiRiEFf9K7IXCK9CgCp89W4PT-kzBIUH-hzHQYH6U5UtzkK93jRoVlYcNUJO853bddogKQmW4ps3Q-2lJlbW8PH4IvXS8a2A7jw4eK_3d0avwNAAD__yXKaq4) to maintain its position as one of the youngest states through 2100. [Texas's young population](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOqzAQheGnMZ3ReGwgFC5uQ5fbbomMGYwlYyM8ySZvv1K23fboK47-r_t8dzHFHP67gyy_tjI7z_FJ802iRDObZrULrKNqyKoBsQeFY9fsdhsW5Q2N_aKc6pTRy6h75wE1DZsBaKJFQAM3QAVdr6F16Dd_g4H0OqoOvTBAa-RytbwT08vVLb3Lk67Wl6NJdmc-q9D_BE4Cpw9A0H1briBwOkvlKnCKWbosXYg5yOw4liw_VJ7lfKTf4aLDxVxlySTLJnkn-S6PHKiywKm57Hp-x5Ri7QdhIBwups8H_rvI0-JPAAAA__9OamSU) is driven by high births, millennials moving into the state, and immigration. By 2050, Texas is forecast to become the third-youngest state, with just 16.7% of its population aged 65 or older.

I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=587dd988bfe34d6b9ae5041b6157201b&_e=OP1N3jkuJrfPxfLOJuXmdqC_WDqFsYXtHT_WhcV7GMC9muAWOfdZOYZd82JHwSs8skrVhHbrIW_R2jvN1X_tLo9wn6QNsmXCUb-3uJ5kCtk2to4VwHQ2Q3Ja9b7EKP6TXXkXpOXgEdNukPkpScatYE73Msc9UMdAmCt-YasBjnKMU9NSMFMEi3y_snM3OGdIRE0dfdtzP72yU0460h98he6itksfFfFrV7gtHhzzaWjfCIJkGyg1XFZ6bHkr0GFYv79yx9LDeWF1rYRteLYq9g%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=587dd988bfe34d6b9ae5041b6157201b&_e=OP1N3jkuJrfPxfLOJuXmdqC_WDqFsYXtHT_WhcV7GMC9muAWOfdZOYZd82JHwSs8skrVhHbrIW_R2jvN1X_tLo9wn6QNsmXCUb-3uJ5kCtk2to4VwHQ2Q3Ja9b7EKP6TEbs7HxPj3-aMDc66SSutjzPmE3zB_t3zSVj61XsMeLNUwss1bl5cz64V16BK_22dSioYaWTu-xVR5BjMMdd9zIX73ZW8WZ0bORhdOOfDlHvHtUE_nf6C6h0Cc3OB7JPKNKpAE0N58tvKWRYCx8BvKw%3D%3D)

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations. As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. body:
MAGA wants to turn their back on Rural America, but NDLB is making a clear message that we need to fight for progress in America's Heartland.
| | | | | |

# **Fighting for Progress in America's Heartland**
---
|
---
| | | | Rural communities across the United States are facing unprecedented challenges, and it's time for us to come together to address them head-on. No Dem Left Behind is leading the charge. We believe that by focusing on critical issues affecting rural America, we can make a real impact in 2024. _Here are the four key issues we're tackling:_ **Rural Hospitals:** Since 2005, 104 rural hospitals in the United States have closed, and an additional 600 are at risk. Democrats understand the importance of accessible healthcare, and we are committed to reversing this trend. Your support will help us elect leaders who prioritize healthcare for all, ensuring that rural communities have the resources they need. **CAFOs & Zoning:** Concentrated Animal Feeding Operations (CAFOs) are threatening community health and the livelihood of family farms. Our Democratic candidates are dedicated to implementing responsible policies that protect both our communities and the environment. By supporting us, you contribute to a future where sustainable farming practices thrive. **Rural Broadband:** **The lack of reliable broadband in rural areas hinders economic growth and limits access to education and healthcare. We support the FCC's efforts to reinstate net neutrality rules, ensuring that** every American, regardless of their zip code, has equal access to the opportunities provided by the internet. Help us bridge the digital divide and connect rural America. **Renewable Incentives:** **Our commitment to a sustainable future is reflected in** the Inflation Reduction Act and American Rescue Plan. By electing Democrats, we ensure that these programs are not only protected but expanded. Let's empower Americans to lead more sustainable lives and provide financial compensation for embracing renewable practices. **We are proud to share that our initiatives extend to key swing states like Pennsylvania, Georgia, and Florida**. By focusing on these states, we aim to create a ripple effect that strengthens our party's presence nationwide. [**_Now, more than ever, we need your support. Your contribution will help us elect Democrats who will champion these causes and build a brighter future for rural America._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2ucn34-e8rxlw-kyd76rh2/)

body:
We’re giving you one more chance!
| **Folks, we reached out to you** with an urgent plea to thank President Biden for all of his service to our country... but according to our records, **_you still have not added your name._**

We’re giving you one more chance! _President Biden deserves all of our gratitude, and we’re sending this tonight at midnight:_

There are 3,205 spots left: [**Read below and sign the letter »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73729?t=6&akid=15865%2E878179%2EbYIXnr) | [3,205 SPOTS LEFT: PLEASE GIVE $3 TO SIGN THIS LETTER BEFORE WE CLOSE IT AT END-OF-DAY TODAY »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73729?t=7&akid=15865%2E878179%2EbYIXnr)
---
Dear President Biden,

I have one thing to say to you: **Thank you.**

You have accomplished so much, and saved our country from the nightmare that Donald Trump left behind.

I remember how excited I was when you won in 2020.

I have had your back since you became President, and I am so proud of everything you've done for working families in our country.

You capped prices on prescription drugs.

You protected good-paying union jobs.

You passed historic legislation addressing climate change.

You have done everything in your power to strengthen our Democracy.

I have zero doubt in my mind: _You will go down as a truly GREAT American President._

**I respect your decision to step aside from the race, and I truly thank you for putting the country and our Democracy first — _that is something that Trump and the Republicans will NEVER do._**

[**I'm signing this letter and sending a small donation of $3 with VPP now to show that I'm still fighting — for our country and for your legacy, Mr. President. It's more important than ever that Democrats stand united together.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73729?t=8&akid=15865%2E878179%2EbYIXnr) | [3,205 SPOTS LEFT: PLEASE GIVE $3 TO INSTANTLY SIGN THIS LETTER BEFORE WE CLOSE IT AT END-OF-DAY TODAY »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73729?t=9&akid=15865%2E878179%2EbYIXnr)

Peter, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=7f1ecda53cad43e290a8470d3c655321&_e=pZ2Rs_hk24GLsosMDApQK021EwHdaelP-iuX-kkM8e9RiVuX1t6s4cDhGNmHSuuvIo58Cs_JkxD1rug-JZakg4JSq-FOWx7a8q3d0WHCUslE5rkLhZzxCf79qIrS4Hw-RGQDghF1diMHseOlqeHjzD3EVA4-3shzflqMAun7Qr7SjMoX615HrTCY5iAmpkl9Tm0jBSp6Q3Ckvk0mtSosSEJ6k5luoDNQHay64cTDyewsIoS0mlP40m3Jr1wiVeRkFJbJws1corXYYUNYvLyk30CmrUuV5YoWl-c_6X7-RhwjJgVvPpRY3jHkKZbm6m5I)_

Peter, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

**I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE.** _**[All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=7f1ecda53cad43e290a8470d3c655321&_e=pZ2Rs_hk24GLsosMDApQK021EwHdaelP-iuX-kkM8e9RiVuX1t6s4cDhGNmHSuuvIo58Cs_JkxD1rug-JZakg4JSq-FOWx7a8q3d0WHCUslE5rkLhZzxCf79qIrS4Hw-RGQDghF1diMHseOlqeHjzMx1KRce-A9G4THUCG1m0-DqTPsUCNP6ZGdBUzqNoW2lMj0oDj_36bT9rdvSC-pOdRN3kS0gT7Mr6l67-MdqRZvTX1M8Jxyxh-ERw8tPLRUWFyJo0UyVZFtEx9Ylcbfp0kCxaYOceUvuBEreObeEJ-y8jephCDYAfP4lGN_SCx3d)**_

Without your response before midnight tonight, our entire dataset will be invalid. So please, tell us now: Who will you vote for? | | | | \---------- Forwarded message ---------- From: White House Alert for you Subject: Will you vote for Vice President Kamala Harris or Donald Trump? | | | dpwillis67@gmail.com: You have been selected to represent Democrats in 43614. Please submit your response by midnight tonight to be counted in our dataset: President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris have made incredible progress during their leadership: expanding affordable health care, investing in our nation's infrastructure and **creating millions of jobs to boost our economy. Meanwhile, Donald Trump continues to undermine the sanctity of our democracy while threatening to pass a national abortion ban, cut Social Security and Medicare benefits, and repeal the Affordable Care Act. As Election Day nears, we're looking for 125 grassroots Democrats from your area to tell us who you'll vote for in November. So please, respond before midnight tonight and tell us: Who will you vote for? | | | | | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ake-launchemail [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ake-launchemail]
Hi Peter,
I am honored to share with you that I am running to succeed the Late Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee to serve as the next Congresswoman for the 18th Congressional District.
The recent passing of Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee has left a major void in the broader community. We are thankful for her years of service. We must honor her strong legacy by continuing and building upon her efforts in addition to bringing forth new solutions, as well. Twenty years ago, I got my start in her D.C. Congressional office. I worked hard and witnessed first-hand that the needs of our community are urgent. I will continue to prioritize the needs of the community, and deliver the results that they deserve.
As a native Houstonian, attorney, and former At-Large Houston Council Member, my experience will enable me to be the type of servant leader that the community needs. My ability to solve complex challenges, as well as to seize opportunities for our community makes me uniquely prepared to deliver for the community both today and tomorrow. My fierce advocacy, and consistent grassroots community-based approach, combined with my ability to bring innovative solutions to the district will benefit the residents in the district tremendously.
We must focus on systemic change as well as bold and innovative solutions to address the many challenges we face concerning infrastructure, health care access, economic opportunity, housing and education. We must also continue to fight for our voting rights, women’s reproductive rights, comprehensive immigration reform, the environment, criminal justice reform and to be safe from gun violence. This fight is for the long haul, and that is what I intend to do as your next Congresswoman. My passion for serving this community has not changed and it never will.
Just as we have seen with President Biden making room for the next generation to lead with Vice President Kamala Harris at the helm this election cycle, it is time to pass the torch forward to the next generation of leadership for the 18th Congressional District that will focus on today and tomorrow. And I am ready for this challenge ahead.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZPGYlSQtPdM [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZPGYlSQtPdM]
Now is the time for us to get to work so we can live in a community and a district where we all can thrive. I need your help to win this election so that I can deliver the change you deserve.
There will be more information to come over the next few weeks, but in the meantime please stay in touch by following us on Twitter, [https://twitter.com/akedwardstx] Facebook, [https://www.facebook.com/amandakedwardstx] and Instagram. [https://www.instagram.com/amandakedwardstx/]
Donate! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ake-launchemail]
Let's get to work!
Amanda K. Edwards
Amanda K. Edwards has the experience and innovative vision to move Houston forward. To learn more, visit our website. Friend,
We've knocked on thousands and thousands of doors. We've made even more phone calls, texts, and sent postcards. The volunteer and grassroots effort has been remarkable. MI01 is organized, energized, and mobilized.
Dr. Bob's ad is on TV, and our digital outreach has exploded! Your support fuels our determination and we must keep our foot on the gas.
MAGA extremist, Trump-endorsed Rep. Jack Bergman has never faced a second-time challenger. On the second leg of a two-cycle strategy, no one is better positioned than Bob Lorinser to give him hell this November.
There's no polling for MI01. It would be dishonest from any campaign to suggest there is.
But, our data tells us, with nearly $1 million invested since 2021, with the name recognition and trust we've built across the district, we're looking at some exciting bumps in Democratic voter turnout — especially with the addition of Kamala Harris for president and maybe a 'dark horse' VP pick from Michigan!
Vice President Harris has Dad's full endorsement.
He's with her.
Precedent in Northern Michigan and the UP shows that a strong top ticket and running for Congress a second time creates winnable margins. We are so encouraged. With tenacity, grit, and perseverance, we have the best opportunity to win in November.
Our battle is uphill. This task will not be easy, but if you're up to it, so is my dad. He has the policies, experience and energy to win. I have a hard time keeping up with him. Like so many of us in the district, he's fired up.
Election Day is Tuesday!
Let's win this.
-Andrew

logo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Screen%20Shot%202023-11-12%20at%207.15.37%20PM.png]
https://www.facebook.com/airdcampaign [https://www.facebook.com/airdcampaign] https://twitter.com/lashrecseaird [https://twitter.com/lashrecseaird] https://www.instagram.com/lashrecseaird/ [https://www.instagram.com/lashrecseaird/]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2830%29.png] New Laws in Effect
Annually on July 1, new laws go into effect from the preceding legislative session. These new Virginia laws range from every possible topic and issue imaginable. To easily review these laws, the Division of Legislative Services provides an updated version of their publication In Due Course [https://dls.virginia.gov/pubs/idc/idc24.pdf] with each new law categorized in one place.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/July/Screenshot%202024-07-26%20at%207.03.46%E2%80%AFPM.png]
We’re pleased that several of our bills have been signed and have gone into effect as well. Specifically, SB483 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb483] which ensures indoor vertical farm operations are treated the same as equipment used in traditional farm operations. Emerging industries like Plenty in Chesterfield and Beanstalk Farms in Manassas now benefit from this legislation and allow for a significant expansion of their investment [https://www.governor.virginia.gov/newsroom/news-releases/2024/june/name-1028639-en.html] in this cutting-edge industry. A few others include:

Furthermore, this is also when the budget goes into effect and all of the funding requests that were approved become available for use.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/July/Screenshot%202024-07-26%20at%207.06.55%E2%80%AFPM.png]
Special attention should also be paid to the new farm law that addresses past misuse of the unlicensed farm use vehicle that’s now in effect. The following vehicles claiming the Virginia Farm Use Exemption must obtain a permanent placard from your local DMV or DMV Select: (i) Pickup trucks with a gross vehicle weight rating Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR); (GVWR) less than or equal to 7,500 pounds (ii) Panel trucks with a gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) less than or equal to 7,500 pounds. AND (iii) SUVs with a gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR). Find out more about these changes here! [https://www.dmv.virginia.gov/vehicles/registration/farm/unregistered]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2830%29.png] Special Session on VMSDEP
On July 18, the Virginia General Assembly returned to Richmond for a Special Session to address the many concerns raised regarding the Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Education Program [https://www.dvs.virginia.gov/education-employment/virginia-military-survivors-and-dependents-education-program-2-2-2] (VMSDEP). VMSDEP, which has been operational for nearly 94 years, is intended primarily to provide college tuition to children of active-duty service members killed or made permanently disabled while serving. After numerous expansions over time, costs have significantly skyrocketed. The program now includes coverage for stepchildren, dependents (the spouse and/or children, in this case) of veterans killed or disabled due to any service-related injury, meaning it didn’t have to be a conflict-related injury or death.
With the action taken during the Special Session earlier budget language was fully repealed and now $90 million will be provided from the fiscal year 2024 surplus to offset the costs of the program — contributing to $65 million each year of the 2024-2026 biennium. This is in addition to the Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission (JLARC) studying how to ensure the program’s long-term viability.
As the daughter of a naval veteran and now representing Fort Gregg-Adams and a district generally with a sizable population of veterans, we recognized firsthand and understand the expense felt by those in service. As we move forward on this issue, we will continue to work alongside the leadership in the General Assembly to ensure the position of those in SD-13 is well represented.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2831%29.png] Updates to the Community & Events Around the District
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/July/Screenshot%202024-07-26%20at%207.10.06%E2%80%AFPM.png]
Hopefully you’ve had an opportunity to join us at one of the many community events we’ve provided legislative updates at. Since May we’ve participated in tens of events and spent time discussing our legislative success and new laws that will have an impact moving forward. A few include:
*

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/July/Screenshot%202024-07-26%20at%207.11.16%E2%80%AFPM.png]
All throughout the district we have witnessed so many advancing in their educational journey by earning their high school diplomas or GED credential. It was particularly special to address the graduation ceremonies for the class of 2024 at Charles City County High School and personally commend the graduates of the Southside Adult Continuing Education GED ceremony.
Surry’s VA250 Committee Launch of Heritage Trail
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/July/Screenshot%202024-07-26%20at%207.13.20%E2%80%AFPM.png]
Established in 2020 [https://va250.org/about/] to commemorate Virginia’s role in the 250th anniversary of American independence, the Virginia American Revolution 250 Commission (VA250) aims to form a more perfect union by educating Virginians about their history and civic duty and sharing diverse narratives that capture Virginia’s complete story and role in shaping the nation. Commemoration related events are already happening throughout Virginia and we were excited to attend the launch of Surry’s Heritage Trail as part of these commemorative events.
The Surry County VA250 Local Committee officially launched the Surry County Cultural Trail: Celebrating the Stories of African and Indigenous Communities, which had been in the works for over a year. The project presents the sites, history, experiences, and contributions of the African descendants and Indigenous People who have lived in Surry County from the 1600’s to today, in the form of a self-guided driving trail. Read more about the tour here [https://www.smithfieldtimes.com/2024/05/16/surry-debuts-driving-tour-highlighting-black-indigenous-history/] .
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/July/Screenshot%202024-07-26%20at%207.14.21%E2%80%AFPM.png]
Trail as part of these commemorative events.
The Surry County VA250 Local Committee officially launched the Surry County Cultural Trail: Celebrating the Stories of African and Indigenous Communities, which had been in the works for over a year. The project presents the sites, history, experiences, and contributions of the African descendants and Indigenous People who have lived in Surry County from the 1600’s to today, in the form of a self-guided driving trail. Read more about the tour here [https://www.smithfieldtimes.com/2024/05/16/surry-debuts-driving-tour-highlighting-black-indigenous-history/] .
Goodr Mobile Grocery Store
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/July/Screenshot%202024-07-26%20at%207.15.37%E2%80%AFPM.png]
Dozens of individuals and families celebrated the ribbon cutting of the brand new Goodr Mobile Grocery Store, which will serve the residents of Petersburg with free and healthy food options and work toward combating the food desert in the City. The Goodr model is critical in a community where food insecurity continues to be a major challenge. As they bring their pop-up grocery experience directly into communities to allow families easy access to food for free, keep up with their schedule and when they will be available here [https://goodr.co/mobile-grocery-store/] .
Read more about the ribbon cutting ceremony here [https://www.12onyourside.com/2024/03/20/new-mobile-grocery-store-tackle-food-insecurity-petersburg/] .
Lamb Healing Arts Groundbreaking
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/July/Screenshot%202024-07-26%20at%207.17.37%E2%80%AFPM.png]
For years the Hopewell Lamb Center for Arts and Healing has been serving the community through their programs for holistic wellness. We joined them for their groundbreaking ceremony–beginning the journey to give them a permanent location to offer their services from.
The Lamb Center for Arts and Healing has been serving the community of Hopewell since 2016 with free healing and art programs that serve more than 7,000 people annually. The acquisition of a permanent operational space is going to prove to be transformational for their continued progress, and I am excited to see the work they will accomplish. Read more about the groundbreaking ceremony here [https://www.progress-index.com/story/entertainment/arts/2024/04/08/hopewell-lamb-center-for-arts-and-healing-groundbreaking-ceremony-lashrecse-aird-mayor-johnny-partin/73216097007/] .
Lamb Healing Arts Groundbreaking
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/July/Screenshot%202024-07-26%20at%207.19.39%E2%80%AFPM.png]
Meta's annual Data Center Community Action Grants program provides direct funding to schools, registered nonprofits and community organizations in locations where they have an operational data center. It was exciting to participate in this year’s program celebrating the community award winners who are dedicated to improving the life of those living in Henrico by enhancing the power of technology to use for community benefit, connecting people online or off, and investing in local science, technology, engineering and math (STEM) education.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2832%29.png] Parks and Recreation Month
Summers are made for making new memories and experiences together while fully appreciating the outdoors. We hope you can do the same, especially if you have children on summer break. In that spirit, July is Parks and Recreation Month and communities throughout the district are home to some of the best parks and recreation teams! Take some time to review the upcoming events around you and enjoy what remains of what has already been a beautiful summer!
Henrico County [https://henrico.gov/rec/] | Prince George County [https://www.princegeorgecountyva.gov/residents/parks_and_recreation/index.php] | City of Petersburg [https://www.petersburgva.gov/144/Recreation-Special-Events-Volunteerism] | City of Hopewell [https://www.hopewellrecandparks.com/] | Dinwiddie County [https://www.dinwiddieva.us/298/Parks-Recreation] | Sussex County [https://www.sussexcountyva.gov/page/recreation/] | Surry County [https://www.surrycountyva.gov/165/Parks-Recreation] | Charles City County [https://www.charlescityva.us/181/Recreation]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2832%29.png] Summer Office Hours
To allow the team time to rest and reset, our offices were closed for summer break from July 4, 2024 through July 22, 2024. All communications received during this time will be responded to and we are grateful for your understanding and patience while we do so.

We plan to start in district office hours at the top of the month! Click the image above to schedule a time to come speak with a representative from my office. We continue to otherwise be accessible via email at senatoraird@senate.virginia.gov or by phone at 804-698-7513.
Thank you for reading our updates, if this email was forwarded to you, please sign up to receive future emails here. [https://www.lashrecseaird.com/contact]

body:
Nadarius Clark, who we helped get elected to the Virginia House of Delegates, just got his gun safety bill passed and signed!
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td0a61f1d-e09b-4c68-a14b-642ccf4b3e90/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
| | | Peter, huge news from Leaders We Deserve’s first elected candidate: Nadarius Clark, who we helped get elected to the Virginia House of Delegates, just got his gun safety bill passed and signed — by a Republican governor, no less! [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T60823428-9c1c-4723-9f27-1b892a769201/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | [Will you make an immediate split donation of $25 to Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action so we can elect even more inspirational young leaders like Nadarius this November?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4f1c1ad1-e6e9-4bb2-89f6-d3f2fb5e6d1e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Stopping gun violence is one of the biggest reasons Nadarius ran for office in the first place, and he knew that even with a Republican governor in office, something had to be done. Nadarius wasn’t willing to sit around and wait years for a Democratic governor with a spine to replace the NRA-backed Republican currently in office, so he started thinking about what he could get done under the current circumstances. He landed on a bill that offers tax credits to gun owners who buy gun locks and safes, so that no gun owner faces a financial barrier to keep their weapons safe and out of the reach of kids and others who shouldn’t be able to get them. Look, I get it — this may not be everything we wanted, but if even one life is saved as a result of this bill, it was worth it. And you can bet that when the current NRA-backed governor is replaced with a Democrat who’s willing to keep our communities safe, Nadarius will be there leading the charge to do even more. What makes all this even more impressive is that Nadarius is the youngest person serving in the Virginia legislature, and his district is the most competitive in the entire state. Last year we gave Nadarius’ campaign about $100,000, and he won by just about 800 votes. That secured a 1 seat majority in the House of Delegates which enabled him to pass this law and kill a separate GOP bill that sought to arm teachers. It’s clear to me that this work is making a difference — but as a grassroots organization that doesn’t take corporate donations, we’re counting on your support to keep going. [Leaders We Deserve has endorsed 13 more candidates for this year’s elections, Peter. Will you split a $25 contribution between Blue Amp Action and Leaders We Deserve right now to support our work so these young candidates can win their elections and start making a difference just like Nada](https://default.salsalabs.org/Teaa8c820-553e-49f7-aa2a-7d1b5209be40/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**[rius](https://default.salsalabs.org/T040f9650-db9d-4377-8f8e-c5d788553af8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T951641e1-64c1-49e5-bbcd-e6e254dc1470/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

clean_body: Will you take a moment to endorse me right now? With your help, I can win this race and flip the Senate for the Republican Party. | My opponent refuses to endorse Kamala Harris for President of the United States because he knows the Biden-Harris Administration has wrecked the U.S. economy and destroyed our borders. Jon Tester also knows that by endorsing Kamala Harris for president, he immediately loses any chance of winning reelection. But what's different now than when he recruited her to run for the Senate in 2015 and endorsed her for VP in 2020? Fellow Conservative, My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican nominee for U.S. Senate from Montana. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority. Literally. My Democrat opponent has a lot of pressure on his back. His colleagues in the Senate, along with every left-wing news outlet in the country, are pinning their hopes of maintaining their majority on his reelection in Montana. Alarms are beginning to sound everywhere. Some news outlets are even penning articles with headlines like, "The Fate of the Senate Depends on Jon Tester. " You'd think that with all the pressure to save his party's Senate majority, he'd embrace the candidacy of the newly minted Democrat nominee for president, Kamala Harris. But in fact, he's the only Democrat in the U.S. Senate who hasn't publicly signaled his support. Here are two things that I know to be true: 1. Jon Tester won't publicy endorse Kamala Harris. 2. You have yet to endorse me in my bid to unseat the Democrat who will decide the "fate of the Senate " As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dream. With just 96 days until Election Day, we're still being outraised 3-1. I'm not sure that will ever change, but what is even more important to me and my team is knowing that we have the support of every Republican in the country as we move into the closing months of this race. . In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I ran; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. Unlike Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign each time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it. I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read. On the battlefield, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the highly trained combat warriors I served alongside as a Navy SEAL. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you. I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. And believe me, there are some tales. I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why Our homeland is in danger. Radical Democrats in Washington want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. This FAR-LEFT liberal agenda is assaulting our society, communities, and the American Dream. The Democrats’ grip on power is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. *If we fail to flip this Montana seat RED this November, we lose our best chance at a Senate Majority for the next DECADE due to the election map at play. Peter, JD Vance is weird. MAGA Republicans are weird. Trump is really weird. Unfortunately though for us, being weird isn't their only problem. JD Vance, Trump, and the rest of the freaks that dominate the GOP have an agenda that threatens to do away with most of things Democrats have been fighting for since the time of President Roosevelt or LBJ. We're talking cuts to Social Security, the elimination of unemployment insurance, the defunding of the WIC and SNAP programs that feed millions of American children, and more. That's not even the tip of the iceberg. Abortion rights, labor protections, and even no-fault divorce are on the chopping block with a Republican trifecta. But don't worry, we have a plan. Folks, you’ve probably heard about Project 2025 by now — the 900-page blueprint created by the conservative think-tank, the Heritage Foundation.
But you may not know the ins and outs of what’s inside. Long story short, it’s a right-wing fever dream — a wish list for a potential Trump presidency that includes attacks on women’s reproductive rights, threats to programs designed to curb climate change, and tax cuts for the richest Americans.
Project 2025 would also threaten the jobs of hundreds of thousands of federal workers — many of whom are Virginians.
In fact, Trump himself said he will ship 100,000 federal jobs out of DC and reclassify another 50,000 civil servants as ‘political appointees’ if he’s elected this November.
Hundreds of thousands of federal workers call Virginia home. And Trump’s attacks on our public servants — many of whom keep our basic services running — should scare us all.
Look, Project 2025 would be disastrous for our Commonwealth and our country. And I’ll do everything in my power to make sure that doesn’t happen — but I need your help to keep Virginia blue and block the GOP from winning here in November.

If that wasn’t enough, Gaza’s health ministry has declared a polio epidemic, the cause of which is the lack of potable water and damage to sewer networks caused by Netanyahu’s genocidal and criminal war against the Palestinians. August 2, 2024
There are many reasons to nominate Dr. Michael Goldstein, but an important one is so that he can explain the biological differences between men and woman so that women's sports aren't destroyed, and women are not maimed by men pretending to be woman while boxing or wrestling.
House Republicans passed a bill, Protect Women in Sports Act, to prevent biological males from participating in women's sports. **[Jim Himes voted against it](https://substack.com/redirect/602e0e97-dceb-4e85-8311-058ce1452801?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)!**
We got a glimpse of the future if Jim Himes and Kamala Harris get their way. The 2024 Olympics allowed an individual with male chromosomes box a woman. Italian boxer Angela Carini entered the ring with Imane Khalif. She took two brutal shots to her head and fearing for her life, immediately surrendered and forfeited the match.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da8ba8bd-9ebb-4d5a-ae18-9192433a6017?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Angela Carini being pummeled by Imane Khalif
President Trump immediately castigated this barbarism, but the silence of Jim Himes and Kamala Harris indicate that they believe Woman Beating should now be an Olympic sport. And if they win their elections, it will soon be an American sport.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/be12d82d-0fd3-42f3-a5be-71c9f8b8dadb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Angela Carini after forfeiting her match so she would not be maimed
Local State Reps Tracy Marra and Tom O'Dea have stood with Riley Gaines (the woman who fought having biological males compete in women's swimming) in her [national challenge](https://substack.com/redirect/e3817334-03d6-475e-8ae1-82e391992686?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the NCAA transgender rules earlier this year. But these State Reps need federal support.
Dr. Goldstein is an ophthalmologist who was retained by the New York State Athletic Commission. He has examined 1,500 boxers including Oscar De La Hoya, Riddick Bowe and Evander Holyfield. He understands that when a man pummels a woman's face, it can cause retinal detachments, orbital fractures (broken bones of the eye socket), cataracts, double vision and life-altering concussions.
Dr. Goldstein's opponent is not a doctor and cannot explain to the voters with the authority of Dr. Goldstein. Jim Himes must be challenged by a doctor for supporting this barbarism to appease his radical base.
Vote for Dr. Michael Goldstein August 13 - EARLY VOTING BEGINS MONDAY.

subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.| | | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=00c2da6bd959444cb535c2f250ce7857&_e=xoAW6OsLydvNnmVoqsR4ZQlsOOn8XJfTItTyGOK9CX81Uaw4U7ciDYBtG2qm7EXWnO54vqX3HPa7tDhCl-a8bOeb9QVT-F3zNedLvl6QPdqaMdqExHbUvMnmY3XhBeWgNSS49pkRkoy_jawExIIlkqST_nmKwG2G_Ru2S-HWuwnv7xnAXyZ5ltgiRes9JG-waxlP72m9rOUgyRUDJV2hlpgaDasUCDlTRSRWmsZaxqkQSghgsiZj379mzfGcQ1CfpjvDhLl5KcVw30swGlJg3w%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=00c2da6bd959444cb535c2f250ce7857&_e=xoAW6OsLydvNnmVoqsR4ZQlsOOn8XJfTItTyGOK9CX81Uaw4U7ciDYBtG2qm7EXWnO54vqX3HPa7tDhCl-a8bOeb9QVT-F3zNedLvl6QPdqaMdqExHbUvMnmY3XhBeWgUYOMUJVT2YSGkE9Gzo8DiKeD-u_znmlxvoBrxyG2rUdVuKsHsZZr8g0RS6iI_FGJXDpNbrdOf_L4k6SKc3ViPh9hQISIAh4X4UzeUujwp4DA_gWLAAO04DSqwZY_jdgP__AwLPpZp-ru6ZqnCaWOLQ%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=00c2da6bd959444cb535c2f250ce7857&_e=xoAW6OsLydvNnmVoqsR4ZQlsOOn8XJfTItTyGOK9CX81Uaw4U7ciDYBtG2qm7EXWnO54vqX3HPa7tDhCl-a8bOeb9QVT-F3zNedLvl6QPdqaMdqExHbUvMnmY3XhBeWgC3GHMOY5xcMtL5BCX8pIuYL_lqvyrvMI-HzbP5lQ2YLoAzmoU53EYU2uENYfeDg3Y92EI3U87ds94FoC9brtdKIl_B2M8Rs5drWsbywX4WR_UVZUKdP_lEOyq8o_uvf-D2rTXosL9Mpq1CieZD0oeg%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=00c2da6bd959444cb535c2f250ce7857&_e=xoAW6OsLydvNnmVoqsR4ZQlsOOn8XJfTItTyGOK9CX81Uaw4U7ciDYBtG2qm7EXWnO54vqX3HPa7tDhCl-a8bOeb9QVT-F3zNedLvl6QPdqaMdqExHbUvMnmY3XhBeWgMvkajxuj-dUjFGJEnoaD6dSXuuJl7Y71igk-wj3Zg11PR8rYgTLLIO-Z1Thc-Vdd_KXfs7zNSPMmsbRkS3ldU376i5-7Wjrr03FxHxi9pg7X8VuhXelaUf365n_VggISlI2RMURgX8HdyUnfamnJuQ%3D%3D)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon

body:
I have come so far in my recovery since this day thirteen years ago.
#

Friends --
August 1, 2011 is a day that I will never forget. It’s the day I made my return to the House floor to cast my first vote after a gunman tried to take my life in January of that same year.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240802-1-30&t=1&akid=8634%2E3935704%2EmopCjz)
I have come so far in my recovery since that moment thirteen years ago. But some days are much more difficult than others. I have aphasia, which makes speaking difficult for me. The words are there in my head, but it’s hard to get them out.
My recovery is a daily challenge. That is why hope is my guiding light. Without hope, I never could have learned to walk and talk again after I was shot. I never could have built up my strength to be where I am today—working alongside you to keep our communities safe from gun violence.
I bring this same hope to our work here at GIFFORDS PAC. Because I dare to hope, I know in my heart that if we keep moving forward together, we can have a future where we no longer live in constant fear of gun violence.
I am so proud to stand with you in our lifesaving work. I couldn’t do this alone.
[**So that is why I’m asking you to make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today. Your support will go straight towards our work to save lives from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240802-1-30&t=2&akid=8634%2E3935704%2EmopCjz)

subject: Winner winner
