body:
Progressives are winning.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240802&t=1&akid=1015%2E587540%2EAZqyay)
**Oscar De Los Santos just won his primary in Arizona!**
With 2,197 votes, our endorsed candidate Oscar has clinched the Democratic nomination for the District 11 seat in the Arizona House of Representatives.
Oscar has led a people-powered campaign focused on the issues that matter most to the everyday folks of Arizona. And he won!
**[Will you join us in congratulating him on a hard-fought victory by signing Oscar’s card, Peter?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/signup/lwd_20240802_primary_win/?source=em20240802&akid=1015%2E587540%2EAZqyay)**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/signup/lwd_20240802_primary_win/?source=em20240802&akid=1015%2E587540%2EAZqyay)
Oscar is a former public school teacher, a Rhodes Scholar, Yale Law grad and one of the most progressive members of the Arizona House of Representatives. In fact when I was first calling Oscar to let him know we were endorsing him he couldn’t pick up and texted me “Sorry I cant talk- repealing the abortion ban rn.” Now THAT is a Leader We Deserve. Unfortunately, Oscar had a serious challenge by an anti-abortion Democrat in his primary so we all came in and helped support him.
He fought like hell to repeal Arizona’s 1864 abortion ban — and won. The MAGA Republicans who control the Arizona House see him as a clear threat and want to see him out of office. **It’s time to fight back.**
With a clear and commanding margin, Oscar now advances to the general election. Arizona will be home to one of the most competitive Senate races in the country this fall (and the presidential is competitive here too). We’re proud to continue to support Oscar as he campaigns for the Democratic ticket in the south side of Phoenix — we’ll be there every step of the way.
For now, let’s congratulate him on a job well done!
**[SIGN THE CARD »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/signup/lwd_20240802_primary_win/?source=em20240802-1015&akid=1015%2E587540%2EAZqyay)**

subject: I took on the Clinton Machine. And I paid the price for it.

body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Aloha - this is Tulsi Gabbard. I
was targeted by my former party for the high crime of standing up
to Hillary Clinton at the height of her power in 2016.

I took on the Clinton Machine.

And I paid the price for it.

Aloha - this is FORMER Democrat Tulsi
Gabbard. My former party came after for me for the high crime of
standing up to Hillary Clinton at the height of her power in
2016.

A lot has changed since then - for
starters, I'm no longer a Democrat.

Like so many, the Democrat Party left
me behind and became the Party of corporate elitists, warmongers,
and anti-freedom propagandists. (In fact, I literally wrote the
book about doing what's RIGHT for our country and LEAVING the
Democrat Party!)

The rot is too deep - it can't be
fixed, it must be driven out entirely.

That's why I'm sending you this email.
I have a plan to bring down the ENTIRE cabal of Elites running
the Democrat Party. We need to raise 100K dollars by tonight so
we can begin to put our plan into action.

We're short of that goal by about 7%.

So - with a humble heart, a spine of
steel, and love of our great country - I respectfully ask you for
a small contribution of 10 or 25 dollars. Will you stand with me?

YES >>_NO >>

We set this ambitious goal because this
is a no-fail mission - we must defeat the Democrat elite at the
ballot box and send a powerful message that we, the people will
not allow those who are destroying our freedom to remain in
power.

Your contribution to our cause of
freedom would make a tremendous difference. So I'm asking you:
Can you please help us?

God bless you. God bless America.

- Tulsi

It's House Majority Leader Steve Scalise.

I'm respectfully asking you to fill out my ELECTION
YEAR CHECK-IN at your earliest convenience. It's important. I
want to have your goals, your concerns, and your priorities in
mind before I do anything else.

What would you like me to keep in mind when I'm
taking on the Radical Democrats?

name: Joe Kent
subject: So my opponent called me “weird”....
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund
body:
Dear Peter,

We are just four days away from Election Day in Washington State! It’s an exciting time because, with your help, we can advance to the General Election and flip this seat from Blue to Red.

Help us do that with a contribution at JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate.

We’ve got TV ads, digital ads, text messaging, mail, and a non-stop town hall schedule helping us get our message out.

And one piece of mail caught my opponent's attention:

I support banning biological men from women’s sports and ensuring collegiate scholarships intended for women only go to real women.

And what was Marie Perez’s reaction?

She calls that weird.

>From her point of view, protecting women and girls is “weird.”

And it isn’t just her opinion; that’s her voting record. She voted against the “Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act” because she supports the Biden-Harris policy of allowing men to invade women’s and girls’ sports, bathrooms, locker rooms, and even battered women’s shelters.

I’m the father of two boys, but I also have a niece. If wanting to protect the women in my family and in yours makes me “weird” to Marie Perez, so be it.

Will you stand with me in defense of our daughters, sisters, wives, and mothers by making a contribution to my campaign today at JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate?

Her calling me weird doesn’t bother me; what bothers me is her refusal to protect women and girls.

She won’t, but I will.

Respectfully,

Joe Kent

P.S. - Perez thinks I’m “weird” because I will protect women and girls’ rights, but name-calling isn’t going to stop me. Stand with me by supporting my campaign at JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate.

Peter, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ae2f8113101c4147af5b4cbb01412abc&_e=yqo3nnzlh9HWrnEAr9jBeUCLvpv0TYhhbZKfic7tEOCx5xlQ1TCnB_IT7aaf3FmfaNrb60UnRG2pDVG3oyLGJiEw2JnaPtakkZLfsj7JTHN0U2OHFPLaJkKOICo0nPn_Y85Ha0wxfO6kIpzg89553-bJWER_V0flokZRk-Uw6G7czVr2KDKLf3dW--nYlAsB5whY6ACT0dqZsJUUVUHvPBvFFnE1it_A82Zndb7zlHsSIKIsKICjucXwx2ai15sKrxhRvcUYVfa6tC2UghwrSceWja0YE51xutn9p9kaO5jAnqdn2ReZbo9gX-d2kgCO)_

Peter, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

**I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE.** _**[All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ae2f8113101c4147af5b4cbb01412abc&_e=yqo3nnzlh9HWrnEAr9jBeUCLvpv0TYhhbZKfic7tEOCx5xlQ1TCnB_IT7aaf3FmfaNrb60UnRG2pDVG3oyLGJiEw2JnaPtakkZLfsj7JTHN0U2OHFPLaJkKOICo0nPn_Y85Ha0wxfO6kIpzg8955320XeLZoSwFSm8fzgzMLCrmeiq0tdb4S89q_Z6JnJkfJtqAgnisTTsMg3RUJ22LBkiekcn28nq4iV2VnASjZjTWOuQEG1EvFNtMHI8ubMz0UI4Fqzn64Vp0zRQji9NGqI6ExoYPWQonYZl2V94xacVL_Hidoe-Dk4HC2roFrzHcN)**_

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Why I decided to run for U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Most of you know I served in the Marines. What you might not know is that the battalion I served in lost more Marines than any other in Iraq.
#

Peter,
Now that we’re officially in the General Election, now that Kari Lake is officially our opponent here in Arizona, I wanted to level with you about why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in the first place.
Most of you know I served in the Marines.
What you might not know is that the battalion I served in lost more Marines than any other in Iraq.
Every day on patrol was a crap shoot. But I got through it because of the guys I went through it with. [**I talk about it here, in one of the first advertisements my campaign put out:**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-lima-aug24.xxa90u&refcode=em240802-1-G15&t=1&akid=2788%2E734936%2E9ZU5W0)
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-lima-aug24.xxa90u&refcode=em240802-1-G15&t=2&akid=2788%2E734936%2E9ZU5W0)
After we got home, I knew I needed to step up and be a brother and a friend to them. I knew that I had to figure out how to get them services, disability pay, recognition.
And after I went to Congress, I started to learn all too well that it wasn’t just the guys I served with who were falling through the cracks. It’s every day Arizonans, it’s moms and dads struggling to make ends meet. It’s women who are seeing their rights taken away. It’s kids growing up like I did who don’t see a future.
More than anything else, that is why I am running for U.S. Senate. To help my community.
It’s not lost on me that Arizona is one of the most important states in the country. That this will be one of the most expensive campaigns of the cycle. And that to defeat Kari Lake, to defeat Trump, to stop the MAGA-right from advancing their agenda, we MUST win here in Arizona.
But I can’t do that alone. Never could.
So, I’m humbly asking you: [**Can you chip in $5 to my campaign and become one of our very first General Election donors? These early days are critical to our chances at success this November.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-lima-aug24.xxa90u&refcode=em240802-1-G15&t=3&akid=2788%2E734936%2E9ZU5W0)

Since I’ve been involved in politics, and especially since I was elected to Congress, I get a lot of questions from friends and family about how they can most effectively impact the outcome of elections. People want to know the best way to help – and the good news is that the answer is pretty simple:
One of the absolute most impactful things you can do to ensure the outcomes we want in the 2024 elections (aside from voting!) is to donate to candidates you believe in.
Not everyone loves that answer. I get it – after reading headline after headline, seeing all the polls, and watching the news every night, we want to DO something. We want to really get involved and give it our all so we can stop seeing horror stories about the extreme GOP and start seeing the progress we all want from our government.
Having the funds to support on-the-ground work is so, so important – and I will definitely be coming to you with volunteer asks as the election draws closer. Having conversations with voters is absolutely a critical part of winning elections, especially if those voters are people who know and trust you because that makes them more likely to listen to what you have to say.
And at this exact moment in the election cycle, your donations have a seriously outsized impact on how things go, because they allow campaigns to scale up outreach, place targeted ad buys that directly reach the most critical undecided voters, and execute plans they’ve been mapping out for months and months.
So, all of that is to say: I can promise you that not only do your online donations MATTER to campaigns, but they actually do seriously heavy lifting when it comes to securing the outcomes we want.
If you want to put this advice into action right now, I would be extremely grateful if you’d chip in whatever you can to my re-election campaign to help me defeat my anti-abortion MAGA opponent and flip the House to a Democratic majority. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

**As Jews around the world prepare for shabbat, I would like to start this off with a moment of silence for the 300 days since the tragic events of the Hamas terror attack at the Nova Music Festival in Israel**.
This is a much more somber shabbat for most. Many believe Israel would strike back and this matter would be resolved quickly despite the world opposition and evaluating their military response under a microscope.

Many also believe that the hostages would have been released by now, but that is not the case. It is tragic to say that yesterday the United States involved American troops in this conflict by sending [12 warships to the Middle East](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/58538600-8514-42eb-9bbd-aeaa773e8d96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

_**The US 's response is due to poor diplomatic management by the United States from Biden/Harris and many of our elected officials and pandering for the Muslim vote.
**_
Israel has been asking for months for the weapons it needs to fight the war on its own. Unfortunately, this lack of support from the United States has resulted in Israel's need to go onto the offensive now in multiple theatres of war. While Israel has been successful in certain missions, and has taken out multiple leaders, including Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh, and others responsible for death of many American soldiers, the likelihood of retaliation is incredibly high. and the US and Israel are preparing for the response from Tehran and its proxy countries.
Netanyahu has said his country is "prepared for any scenario -- both defensively and offensively," and added that Israel "will exact a very heavy price for any act of aggression against us." ([source](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f3a237c1-8a04-49f9-a729-9aaffa10d6b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
As a result, almost all airline carriers have [cancelled service](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4010e8de-f633-4db5-9ba6-17c430807ffd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Israel stranding Israelis around the world and isolating it once again.

As a Jewish American in the United States, it is disappointing to hear from Israelis that they feel safer in Israel under a threat of attack from multiple Arab nations then they do in the United States. What they're referring to is the unbelievable amounts of antisemitic behavior and sanctioned attacks from these "peaceful protesters" that destroy property, desecrate our nations capitol attack Jews and supporters of Israel while chanting for Free Palestine.

Unfortunately, most American leadership, especially in Democrat controlled cities have done nothing. There was a massive counter protest in Times Square earlier this week with children injured by a protestor with pepper spray (See [article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2e1b0a39-6c9c-48e8-a2e4-ee99d856654f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
It is really disgusting to see Biden/Harris and many top democrats snub Benjamin Netanyahu. Vice President Harris, the presidential nominee for the Democrat party at this point, decided to go to speak with sorority sisters and secure the black vote over showing support for our most important ally in the Middle East and our proxy soldiers to take on Iran.

As the Democrats search for a VP nominee, PA Governor Josh Shapiro, has been presented as a possible candidate. That will likely not happen due to the strong Muslim vote from Minnesota and Michigan putting pressure on the Democrat party not to put a Jewish man as a VP candidate.

As Netanyahu said last week in one of the most powerful speeches to the Joint Session of Congress, **NEVER AGAIN IS NOW**. [See our article on his historic speech](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/biden-and-harris-snub-israel?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web).
Chants of "**Heil Hitler** " are yelled at the [Olympics](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/22b6ee82-f21c-4884-b51a-56cc495fc3be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an event to bring out the best in the world and unify through healthy competition.

In the aftermath of October 7, antisemitism here in Connecticut is incredibly high. In Westport, posters of all the hostages were placed on the Ruth Steinkraus Cohen Memorial Bridge were vandalized. Yesterday, Run4TheirLives-Westport and other humanitarian organizations will held a vigil on that Bridge to replace those hostage posters. (see [WestportLocalPress: Anti-Semitism](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3b548226-9291-4527-9d9e-dd84129c292b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). Grassroots organizations have grown since October 7th throughout the country, including Run4TheirLives and the local chapters that have sprouted up to bring awareness. In January, Melinda Wasserman created the Westport chapter of that group.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d09ed539-3a6e-4d7c-8486-bbe5f2500e63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It was great to participate last night and see such unity and solidarity in the Westport community and this will only continue.
It is tragic to see destruction of property and overt displays of antisemitism throughout the 4th District, including swastikas painted at AITE High School in Stamford (See **[Swastikas, racial slur found painted at Stamford's AITE high school](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b07dd7d5-a0bf-48fe-bf64-dea1ad644b6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))**

If you are reading this and are asking yourself what you can do - I have some suggestions:
1. **Check in on your Jewish Friends** and see how they are. Many are walking in fear to hide any chains and jewelry with Stars of David or in Hebrew
2. J**oin These Groups** \- The Westport group of Run4TheirLives leads marches on Sundays at 11 AM starting at Playhouse Square. For a list of locations[ click here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/65039d61-b037-4384-a495-3626e180d963?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
3. **Vote for politicians who truly support Israel and not in Name Only**.

**I am the most pro-Israel candidate running for Congress.** I firmly support Israel's right to defend itself and I am appalled at how America has ignored its most important ally in the Middle East and first line of defense against Iran and other Arab nations.
**On August 13 th, Stand up for America, Israel and against Antisemitism and VOTE GOLDSTEIN ON AUGUST 13 so I can take on Jim Himes who is not a supporter of Israel and has supported CAIR while taking money from AIPAC.**
I would be honored by your support.
Sharing is Caring - so if you like the message please pass it on.
Thank you for your continued support.

body:
Peter—

By now, you’ve probably seen all the evidence you need to know that Kari
Lake can’t be allowed anywhere near the Senate. But U.S. Senator Kari Lake
might be more likely than we think.

This race is closer than ever. First, a fresh poll showed Kari and Ruben
tied. Soon after, a respected polling outfit projected Kari Lake as the
likely winner in Arizona. And just a couple days ago, a brand new poll of
likely voters in Arizona showed Kari defeating Ruben by one point.

This will be one of the closest Senate races in the

subject: You'll be proud to say you helped elect Sarah McBride
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
"Today, anti-trans forces had to come before a trans person in the big chair – me."
#
_"For years, trans people have had to go before anti-trans lawmakers in the big chair. Today, anti-trans forces had to come before a trans person in the big chair – me."
\- Sarah McBride_
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240802-1?refcode=em20240802-1-930&amount=5&refcode2=930_21716_An1qd8&akid=930%2E21716%2EAn1qd8)
Hi, it's David Hogg.
Last week marked the 7-year anniversary of Donald Trump **reversing decades of progress** by BANNING transgender people from serving in the military.
**Back then, there wasn't a single transgender member of Congress to stand up to Trump... there still isn't. Which is why my organization, Leaders We Deserve, has endorsed Sarah McBride in her race to represent Delaware in the U.S. House.**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240802-1?refcode=em20240802-1-930&amount=5&refcode2=930_21716_An1qd8&akid=930%2E21716%2EAn1qd8)
Sarah would be the FIRST-ever transgender member of Congress — after already being the first openly transgender person elected to a state senate seat. It is CRITICAL that we have her voice not just at the table but at the head of the table, as Republicans launch nonstop attacks on the trans community.
[**We need young progressive leaders like Sarah in office. Can you make a $5 donation to her campaign to help her win her primary election in a few weeks?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240802-1?refcode=em20240802-1-930&amount=5&refcode2=930_21716_An1qd8&akid=930%2E21716%2EAn1qd8)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240802-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240802-1-930&refcode2=930_21716_An1qd8&akid=930%2E21716%2EAn1qd8)**
Listen, I know as a supporter of Sarah McBride that I don't have to tell you representation matters. You're here because you KNOW it does.
So I won't explain why it's so important to end the absence of transgender people at the table in Congress. Instead, I'm going to tell you why Sarah is so damn amazing.
**She's been a political badass for years.** Sarah worked for the late Attorney General Beau Biden and served in the Obama-Biden White House. Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. [ ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f15cbf8ac9374bbdabdc419ae24533fc&_e=Gs3ulJiTHbNml82JwTy62K3nuuI_1Lyps2GPKtUDZ_oL-2KqF5FSiD2yYvydE90uEQ8giaIE6Fkf_FT58_zrDHphd4zywIJzE-P8C6C5F419TKlcfN3VhdDdAjVl5ZHByoIK0N0qdHqQzB01DErBheAqwxQXgBcMuKbZJ6mHwOMW-SXHtuiwIdHBw1OV5L_9p1eZcI-_yYTgTddB-lfegjD7AzdVO8AV2rT8XFU-uGATvuHrb84SmC3KNJL3pduQisXzzPB-cVdtPzdoO1MyfbcX24WihPuqXZUnVUoOPlAHA1XRHQkyTJsu3Mr74l0MCFhZjnjDoRvd24t5WXK0_lG-5ZtJf05AlXA4jdLgPC2dY5FJalDjucQrbiYQuJeoMMO1DjoybrbnDLf0We_7r8F8iyueR0o8kfAGcQ3Z3mw%3D)
Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f15cbf8ac9374bbdabdc419ae24533fc&_e=Gs3ulJiTHbNml82JwTy62K3nuuI_1Lyps2GPKtUDZ_oL-2KqF5FSiD2yYvydE90uEQ8giaIE6Fkf_FT58_zrDHphd4zywIJzE-P8C6C5F419TKlcfN3VhdDdAjVl5ZHByoIK0N0qdHqQzB01DErBheAqwxQXgBcMuKbZJ6mHwOMW-SXHtuiwIdHBw1OV5L_9p1eZcI-_yYTgTddB-lfegjD7AzdVO8AV2rT8XFU-uGATvuHrb84SmC3KNJL3pduQisXzzPB-cVdtPzdoO1Myfce30JC_lF3TyhEHj7aOYVe_k0xj5hU3H8XFkLqpxyib-BIqgal4eF5inJVyfd6VDU90_9I8FG32SXDyCNKMU2Lszj8SiDiLJu2O97wDXevqsmZX2ruVtqXjqYJHbh3twazwDdCcfVJD6L1tUr9LnW4%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

body:
Being Olivia’s big sister taught me so much and shaped the person I am today.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90094994/489398398/2145945666?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2024.08.01_Olivia_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmFiYzc3OS1mODUwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hBnjabs6dgZmeruY1ojX4GzZnz44-frlpXrv-ohFMR0=&emci=8557e140-ec50-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ebabc779-f850-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=23483442) | Dear Peter, This is a longer email, but it’s important I share the story of my sister, Olivia. Being Olivia’s big sister taught me so much and shaped the person I am today. Olivia was born with microcephaly, which meant her head and brain were smaller than expected. From birth, she required complex medical care, surgeries, and equipment — wheelchairs, feeding pumps, and a nebulizer. While my dad’s union job provided some coverage, it fell short of covering everything Olivia required. **But our family was able to give Olivia everything she needed thanks to Medicaid.** Medicaid covered Olivia’s equipment, our appointments at Mary Bridge and Tacoma General Hospital, and home visits for early intervention specialists, nurses, and therapists. When the Washington legislature expanded Medicaid funding in 1993,**I learned that state lawmakers can have a life-changing impact!** Being Olivia’s big sister changed my life. At a young age, I became a caregiver: Changing diapers, hooking up Olivia’s feeding tube, making sure she got her medication, and holding her hand when she had seizures. **At school, I heard insults, cruel jokes, and the R slur — and I began my lifetime opposition to bullies in all their forms.** Olivia passed away in 2012, and I carry her memory with me every day. James Baldwin b. August 2, 1924
Today would've been James Baldwin's 100th birthday. And while you may not yet know it, his answer to this critical and important question--posed by a white Yale professor no less--is exactly the answer you were looking for. As a young law student, Baldwin's writings on social, racial, and economic justice were a transformative experience to my development and growth as a lawyer. His work helped inspire my desire to delve into human rights law.
James Baldwin passed away in 1987. But nearly four decades later, his wisdom resonates as powerfully today as it did during his lifetime. Take a listen to his answer, and share it with someone in your network who might benefit from Baldwin's sage advice. **Let 's Address This.**
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=147283709&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ3MjgzNzA5LCJpYXQiOjE3MjI2MjE1MTIsImV4cCI6MTcyNTIxMzUxMiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.dcYmfFAxdVWU7rJcaWPvcPU5yMCnJohbhvbJiMbVeII)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/df23a5e3-a6f0-4688-a418-9c486b11d599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

The first time I listened to this clip, I marveled when Baldwin asks and answers, "Do the labor unions hate me? I don't know. _That doesn 't matter_." That part, "that doesn't matter," rang loudly. Baldwin beautifully speaks to the need to look past individual words or intentions, and instead recognize collective and systemic injustices that uphold systems of white supremacy. Collection action speaks louder than individual words.
As we now see virulent attacks on Kamala Harris for her identity as a Black woman and as an Indian woman, spikes in anti-Muslim and antisemitic hate crimes, and rises in anti-Black violence, particularly from white supremacists--Baldwin's wisdom is more critical than ever before.
Therefore, it is up to us to work together--brown, Black, Latino, white, and Indigenous--to dismantle the systems of white supremacy that continue to plague our nation. Doing so requires recognition of the injustices that exist today, taking meaningful action to undo this injustices, and building better systems ensuring meaningful equal economic, social, and racial justice for all people in this country.
That's the vision James Baldwin had for our nation, and on his 100th birthday, the work continues. Thank you all for being in this fight for justice with me.

| | Friends, The Indiana State Fair is officially open as of Today! The fair brings an excitement to the state that is undeniable and we can't wait to take part in it with all of you. Peter,
Cori's primary is next Tuesday. So, these next couple of days are all about organizing and getting the word out about Cori, our district, and our opponent.
As you know, Cori is facing relentless attacks from AIPAC’s far-right megadonors. They’re spending millions on attack ads in our district, trying to drown out our voices and install someone who will bow to some of the GOP’s biggest funders. Why: If you prefer to stay behind the scenes or reach people from the comfort of your home, phonebanking is a perfect option.
How: We’ll equip you with scripts and tips to make your calls impactful and engaging.
Every conversation we have, every door we knock, and every call we make brings us one step closer to keeping an unwavering champion in this seat who truly represents us.
Your time and effort are invaluable in this fight.

Together, we can push back against these attacks and show that our district is not for sale. Let’s rally behind Cori and show the strength of our community.
In solidarity,
Marquis Govan, Field Director

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Fighting for our farmer’s futures
body:
https://www.tamiewilson.com/ [https://www.tamiewilson.com/]
Friends ,
Ohio farmers are the backbone of our community, providing us with the food we eat and the resources we rely on.
Yet, they have been neglected and undermined far too long.
My opponent, Jim Jordan, has consistently failed our farmers and his record speaks for itself.
He has voted against every version of the Farm Bill since he was elected in 2007.
These important bills would have eliminated monopolies, provided necessary funding and resources to our farmers to ensure they could manage risks, access credit, and receive essential disaster relief.
Worst of all, Jordan’s support for the Trump administration’s reckless trade wars has almost completely devastated Ohio’s agricultural sector.
He touted these policies as a win for American workers, but Ohio’s farmers suffered.
I come from a family of farmers, so I know the blood, sweat, and tears that go into trying to make ends meet. Ohio farmers have struggled for far too long. If you want a leader in Washington who will fight for agriculture workers, not sell them down the river like Jim Jordan - contribute today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240802_farmers_link1] Jim Jordan’s record on agriculture is so bad that farmers across Ohio and the country took a stand against his bid for Speaker of the House
They launched a powerful grassroots campaign that prevented him from gaining more power.
They understood that his consistent opposition to Farm Bills and alignment with policies that hurt agriculture workers make him an unsuitable leader for the House.
Our farmers are tired of being used as political pawns and want someone who truly understands and represents their needs.
Protecting our farmers is personal to me. I grew up visiting and working on my uncle’s farm in Gallipolis, Ohio, near the Bob Evans Farm.
As your next Congresswoman, I’ll make sure our farmers are getting a square deal – here’s what that looks like:
1. I will fight to ensure farmers are protected and set up for success by breaking up monopolies like the large meat-packing companies and seed suppliers that dominate the agriculture industry.
2. I will work to enact legislation that addresses and resolves the water crisis, including issues related to water runoff, ensuring farmers and their workforce have reliable and clean access.
3. I will make it easier for farmers to adopt eco-friendly practices, striving to improve sustainability and secure a greener future for agriculture.
4. I will fight to preserve generational farming by advocating for policies that support our local farmers and by cutting the inheritance tax, ensuring that family farms can be passed down without financial burden.
That’s just the start.
Farming is not just a job; it’s a way of life that requires unwavering dedication and support.
I’m proud of my family's roots, and I’ll never stop advocating for our nation’s farmers in Washington.
Join me in this fight to uplift and empower the farmers who feed our nation. Contribute to our campaign today and help us bring real change to Ohio’s agricultural sector. Together, we can ensure that our farmers have the resources and support they need to raise the next generation of American farmers. Friend: When I was growing up, I never could have imagined that I'd run for elected office one day – let alone become the first computer programmer and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the Senate.
As the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, I was surrounded by loved ones who taught me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I've carried these with me my entire life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90097154/489406205/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4272-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODM2YTMxZC1mYjUwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ow6iPkWiUrmXI7JrkKgEBlQDU0Vtu3MAavsefnVKeDw=)
I carried those values with me when I was working as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace to pay for college, becoming the first in my family to graduate. I carried them with me when I was working as a computer programmer in a male-dominated field.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90097155/489406206/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4272-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODM2YTMxZC1mYjUwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ow6iPkWiUrmXI7JrkKgEBlQDU0Vtu3MAavsefnVKeDw=)
I carried those values with me during my first-ever campaign for Congress in 2016, when I flipped a highly competitive district from red to blue,**and in 2018, when I defeated a Republican incumbent against all odds – becoming the second woman senator in Nevada's history.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90097156/489406207/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4272-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODM2YTMxZC1mYjUwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ow6iPkWiUrmXI7JrkKgEBlQDU0Vtu3MAavsefnVKeDw=)
To this day, those values of hard work, determination, and persistence fuel my fight to advocate for working families and bring much-needed progress to the lives of all Nevadans.
**But right now,_CNN_ is calling me the most vulnerable woman in the Senate – and _The Cook Political Report_ is calling Nevada the "most perilous" battleground for Democrats.**
The GOP will come after me with everything they've got, and I simply cannot fight back without your grassroots support. **[So please, friend, will you contribute $5 or more today to help me defend my seat and protect our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90097157/489406208/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4272-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODM2YTMxZC1mYjUwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ow6iPkWiUrmXI7JrkKgEBlQDU0Vtu3MAavsefnVKeDw=)**

#
Friend of Life,

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? I'm asking 50 people to step forward today with a $50 gift to help us put our life-saving videos into classrooms nationwide**. **[https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ea40555695e144a6aa3293d6c6729ef3&_e=WTQc2IPR7oa-0JzE7JyyeCSrAF6_KoEOl7T40NG2CxqzVQtzpK4QMVqCU6lpUEZBz8qzOL5MU26ZjiBFjOdevRHOacIORKYqa-gSEwqgC-2Ae4CXz_aC5QRAb5H6CEENp1c0tzx7letyYIxdw2lSXx97fj_9jWWrIBOdhUzFyDhlCD5gpd_FS1uzJcKzGAJuScahXNZ7A1P1iVXAJbpTJlc3gZs8TZU6qFwPkXpTwgp_3JfaUjeSuKS8bKsJwULC87UpEvBW7Bex0hOHXi-GjS-LpfrFIlIkkVxjPGWxVS6j-se0klumbPe_FnyipzqAgb3EM0L1sLvg0p2pQmVfP1qkbitK8DlIbpVe4X2wf6I%3D)**

Planned Parenthood has continuously pushed egregious and pornographic materials in schools to young kids and teens -- and what do they "teach" these impressionable kids about sex? That disturbing practices are "normal" and "healthy."

In classic Planned Parenthood fashion, irrefutable definitions are warped, and morality is thrown out the window.

Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

**We need to protect our children against Planned Parenthood 's deception. This deadly organization should not be the educator of our children. **

Friend of Life, this is why we at Live Action have been creating - and are about to release! - wholesome sex-ed video series for schools across the country to use instead of Planned Parenthood's damaging materials.

We need to spread the truth about loving relationships between men and women and the beauty of procreation before the next generation of parents is convinced by Planned Parenthood's disturbing agenda that leads to abortion.

**But we can 't complete this critical initiative without your support. Your gift of $50 will help us complete the videos and get them into schools across the country. Use this secure link to make your gift and kick Planned Parenthood out of the classroom! [https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ea40555695e144a6aa3293d6c6729ef3&_e=WTQc2IPR7oa-0JzE7JyyeCSrAF6_KoEOl7T40NG2CxqzVQtzpK4QMVqCU6lpUEZBz8qzOL5MU26ZjiBFjOdevRHOacIORKYqa-gSEwqgC-2Ae4CXz_aC5QRAb5H6CEENp1c0tzx7letyYIxdw2lSXx97fj_9jWWrIBOdhUzFyDhlCD5gpd_FS1uzJcKzGAJuScahXNZ7A1P1iVXAJbpTJoWNoz-QFVp-uUV4EkM7G6S3pHRotFJbBHuzM6SUF3uTtjpePnO2IiOeW8A6kFFa8GomnAyBW0JvAUvrzxn2iH3fEgouPSlYCXwWYPW_dYE2Ieh90WO_2YLH1bXqnGyig3NBjE4RBpJLWoPRDl2kbCg%3D)

For Life,

Lila Rose

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240802-2?refcode=em20240802-2&refcode2=3752_552475_Vg28vs&akid=3752%2E552475%2EVg28vs)
Hey Peter — it's Joseph Gordon-Levitt here. You may know me as an actor, but this is NOT me plugging my latest movie. (Although _Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F_ did just come out, and it’s not bad 😜)
**What I actually want to talk to you about is one of the most important U.S. Senate races in the country: Jacky Rosen's reelection in Nevada.[I'll explain why I'm fully behind Jacky — but if you're short on time, I hope you'll join me in splitting $5 between her campaign and Bob Casey right now to keep Nevada and the Senate blue.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240802-2?refcode=em20240802-2&refcode2=3752_552475_Vg28vs&akid=3752%2E552475%2EVg28vs)**
**[Split $5 Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240802-2?refcode=em20240802-2&refcode2=3752_552475_Vg28vs&akid=3752%2E552475%2EVg28vs)**
I’ve been incredibly lucky in my life, and so I try to do what I can to bring a little positivity to the world. And that’s why I’m doing all I can to help Jacky win her race in Nevada. She's fought to create good-paying jobs, protect reproductive freedom, and defend American democracy itself.
**But here's the nastier side of politics: With our Democratic Senate majority riding on Jacky's race, dark money groups and super PACs aligned with Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell are pouring millions of dollars into defeating her.**
**[So I'm personally asking you to help Jacky fight back and win: Will you split a donation of $5 or whatever you can spare between Bob Casey and Jacky Rosen to reelect Jacky Rosen in Nevada and protect our Senate majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240802-2?refcode=em20240802-2&refcode2=3752_552475_Vg28vs&akid=3752%2E552475%2EVg28vs)**
I know you're likely nervous about the outcome of things come November. I am, too. We're reading the same headlines. Worrisome polls, unthinkable Supreme Court decisions, and our fundamental freedoms and democratic norms in the cross-hairs.
Unfortunately, with the Supreme Court's recent ruling on presidential immunity — effectively putting presidents above the law — Donald Trump could take his worst impulses even further if reelected. Our future depends on the Senate, and the Senate depends on what happens in battleground Nevada this year. Each one of us has to do all we can to help Jacky win, so I'm personally counting on you.
**With the stakes this high, none of us can sit on the sidelines. So please, join me in making an impact:[Split a contribution of $5 or more now between Jacky Rosen’s campaign and Bob Casey to help Jacky win in Nevada and defend our Democratic Senate majority.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240802-2?refcode=em20240802-2&refcode2=3752_552475_Vg28vs&akid=3752%2E552475%2EVg28vs)**

Joseph Gordon-Levitt

---
| | The Heritage Foundation, an extreme far-right think tank, has spearheaded a plan for the next Republican administration to **radically transform the federal government and dismantle as many progressive policy victories as possible,** including and especially climate and environmental policies. Their blueprint calls for gutting or abolishing federal agencies, replacing civil service experts with far-right political appointees, eliminating environmental standards, and dramatically rolling back reproductive rights and rights for LGBTQ+ Americans.

* **Dramatically increase destructive oil and gas drilling and fracking** on public lands, on our coastlines, and in the Arctic.

* **Eliminate offices within the Energy Department that focus on renewable energy,** climate technology, and energy technology research.
* **Eliminate energy efficiency standards for household appliances** that save Americans money and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

With just days until our August 6 primary election, **everything we do now until Election Day counts.**

Wesley is committed to bringing real leadership back to St. Louis. That’s why we need to do everything we can to ensure we help him cross the finish line strong on August 6.

In Congress, Wesley will:
* Fight to strengthen our economy by focusing on workers, job training, and skills development
* Lower health insurance and prescription drug costs to make healthcare more accessible for every St. Louisan
* Stand up for seniors to protect their rights and well-being
* Protect reproductive freedom for all to ensure everyone has control over their own bodies and healthcare decisions
* Take on special interests to tackle climate change and protect our planet for future generations

# Let Us Fulfill Our Duty:
### Register and Vote!
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Aug 2
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
As we approach another crucial election cycle, I want to bring to your attention a matter of great importance that affects us all as faithful stewards of our responsibilities as citizens of this great Nation.
It is both disheartening and alarming to note that 30% of Christians are currently not registered to vote. This statistic represents not just an opportunity lost, but a significant gap in our collective voice as people of faith. Our faith calls us to be active participants in the society we live in, standing up for the values and principles we hold dear.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/197c02a4-7bf8-4553-aaa6-94c82857f0f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In the coming months, let us take up the responsibility and ensure that every Christian within our reach is not only registered to vote but also committed to making their voice heard at the polls this November. Voting is not merely a civic duty; it is an extension of our Christian witness, reflecting our commitment to justice, righteousness, and the common good.
Here are a few steps we can take to encourage and support voter registration and turnout:
1. **Share Information** : Educate friends and family about the importance of registering to vote and the impact their votes can have on our nation's future.
2. **Provide Resources** : Direct them to reliable resources for voter registration, including deadlines and necessary documentation.
3. **Organize Events** : Host or participate in voter registration drives and informational meetings to mobilize our community.
4. **Pray** : Let us pray for wisdom and discernment as we approach the polls, seeking God's guidance in all our decisions.

Let us honor our calling by ensuring that our voices are not only heard but are a testament to our faith and convictions. Your participation is crucial, and I encourage you to take action today.

Voting is not merely a civic duty; it is an extension of our Christian witness, reflecting our commitment to justice, righteousness, and the common good. Here are a few steps we can take to encourage and support voter registration and turnout: 1. Share Information : Educate friends and family about the importance of registering to vote and the impact their votes can have on our nation's future. 2. Provide Resources : Direct them to reliable resources for voter registration, including deadlines and necessary documentation. 3. Organize Events : Host or participate in voter registration drives and informational meetings to mobilize our community. 4. Pray : Let us pray for wisdom and discernment as we approach the polls, seeking God's guidance in all our decisions. Let us honor our calling by ensuring that our voices are not only heard but are a testament to our faith and convictions. Your participation is crucial, and I encourage you to take action today. It is my honor to write to you today as the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in the great state of Tennessee!

Last night’s Primary Election success belongs to you—our dedicated grassroots supporters. Your hard work and unwavering commitment have brought us to this pivotal moment. We now enter the general election stronger than ever.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90101384/489420635/550126324?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240802_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI3OGE3NzgzLTAzNTEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Afre8NHRY-8r-jLshlfuRQnXl9Rl_hUga1vdpMpdyzc=)
**But we can't rest. Not for a second. We're facing the most critical election of our lifetime, and we need to keep our momentum at full throttle.**

[_We're launching an Official Democratic Nominee Fund with an ambitious goal of raising $200,000 in the next five days. Every dollar will amplify our message and fund critical voter outreach through Election Day. Can you split a donation between Defeat Republicans and my campaign right now to fuel the final stretch of our campaign and help us defeat my far-right opponent, Marsha Blackburn?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90101386/489420637/550126324?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240802_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI3OGE3NzgzLTAzNTEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Afre8NHRY-8r-jLshlfuRQnXl9Rl_hUga1vdpMpdyzc=)

Look, Marsha has failed us for too long. She’s voted against everything from pandemic relief to ensuring equal pay for women. She’s supported tax breaks for corporations while opposing laws to keep life-saving drug prices down. She even voted against protecting contraception at the federal level and aggressively pushed to ban reproductive rights in all 50 states.

Marsha is a danger to everyday working people and families, cruel to LGBTQ+ folks, and she refuses to fight for our right to vote.

**And to top it all off, she's proudly endorsed by Donald Trump, bringing his brand of extremism front and center in this race.**

The next few months won’t be easy. Marsha is backed by wealthy mega-donors who will stop at nothing to keep her in office. But mark my words: the movement that we’ve built—made up of grassroots supporters from all walks of life—CAN defeat Marsha in November. And we will.

I'm ready to outwork, outraise, and out-organize Marsha Blackburn. With your help and our shared vision for Tennessee, I know we can shake up the status quo in Washington and move our state forward.

Imagine a better future for Tennessee: Extremism? We’ll reject it. Reproductive rights? We’ll defend it. Our democracy? We’ll fight for it. Better opportunities for working families? You bet we’ll make it happen.

But we can't slow down now.

[_I need your support now more than ever to kick off these final months on a strong foot. Can I count on you to split a donation toward our Official Democratic Nominee Fund right now to help us bring home the win in November?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90101389/489420639/550126324?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240802_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI3OGE3NzgzLTAzNTEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Afre8NHRY-8r-jLshlfuRQnXl9Rl_hUga1vdpMpdyzc=)

# Let Us Fulfill Our Duty:
### Register and Vote!
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Aug 2
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
As we approach another crucial election cycle, I want to bring to your attention a matter of great importance that affects us all as faithful stewards of our responsibilities as citizens of this great Nation.
It is both disheartening and alarming to note that 30% of Christians are currently not registered to vote. This statistic represents not just an opportunity lost, but a significant gap in our collective voice as people of faith. Our faith calls us to be active participants in the society we live in, standing up for the values and principles we hold dear.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9d8e33a6-1c08-405a-91f1-03f7453319fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In the coming months, let us take up the responsibility and ensure that every Christian within our reach is not only registered to vote but also committed to making their voice heard at the polls this November. Voting is not merely a civic duty; it is an extension of our Christian witness, reflecting our commitment to justice, righteousness, and the common good.
Here are a few steps we can take to encourage and support voter registration and turnout:
1. **Share Information** : Educate friends and family about the importance of registering to vote and the impact their votes can have on our nation's future.
2. **Provide Resources** : Direct them to reliable resources for voter registration, including deadlines and necessary documentation.
3. **Organize Events** : Host or participate in voter registration drives and informational meetings to mobilize our community.
4. **Pray** : Let us pray for wisdom and discernment as we approach the polls, seeking God's guidance in all our decisions.

Let us honor our calling by ensuring that our voices are not only heard but are a testament to our faith and convictions. Your participation is crucial, and I encourage you to take action today.

**Missouri 's election-winning labor movement is united behind our campaign to defeat Josh Hawley.**
In their recent endorsement, the United Steelworkers called me "the only pro-worker candidate in this race" and made a clear contrast between my record and Hawley's "pro-worker" election-year charade:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e423a2ad-4513-4636-88a0-7fc8b31252bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If you've been to one of our campaign events, you've probably seen some signs that say MAKE SH*T IN AMERICA AGAIN! That's more than a slogan. It's a policy priority.
Missourians have been making things for decades -- but in recent years, our politicians have let giant corporations hollow out manufacturing and sell off our strategic industries to the highest bidder. I know that union workers can build the next generation of industry right here in Missouri, and that everything from our supply chains to our national security depends on America once again taking the lead. That's why in the Senate, I'll fight to empower and invest in our workers every day like our future depends on it -- because it does.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f0b4868a-3479-4668-bd8e-6593debf710f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Unions are the strongest tool everyday people have to take back power in this country. And from the picket line to the floor of the U.S. Senate, I'll always fight for the right of American workers to organize -- in the private and public sectors, for workers and retirees.
That's why dozens of statewide and local unions have endorsed my campaign. Here are just a handful:

[1]Powered By People

Our Powered by People volunteers meet future voters where they are.
Wherever they are.

This past Saturday our North Texas team set up a registration drive at a
Swiftie Market Fest in Dallas.

Caitlen reports that “we had an AMAZING event with, from left to right
next to the modified Grimace: Mary, John, Laura, Stephanie and Melissa,
who goes by 'Mudd', with her four kids.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240802.NlXs6H&refcode=ema20240802-239741&t=1001&akid=239741%2E444211%2EJYREqi ]Mary, John, Laura, Stephanie, and Melissa at the Swiftie Market Fest in
Dallas

We registered 24 people and added 72 more to our relational organizing
network (which allows us to stay in touch with them through election day).
Here’s a picture of Stephanie registering a new voter.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240802.NlXs6H&refcode=ema20240802-239741&t=1002&akid=239741%2E444211%2EJYREqi ]Stephanie registering a new voter at the Swiftie Market Fest in Dallas

Caitlen and the North Texas team are getting it done!

Just like hundreds of other Powered by People volunteers all over the
state. They’re on college campuses. At farmers’ markets. Tax offices.
Country music concerts and barbers’ colleges. And now Swiftie Markets,
too.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240802.NlXs6H&refcode=ema20240802-239741&t=1003&akid=239741%2E444211%2EJYREqi ]Please support our volunteers. Make sure they have the resources in the
field to reach, register and turn out the voters who will power key
Democratic victories up and down the ballot.

Your contribution supports the only voter registration program in the
country that:

* Is volunteer led
* Exclusively registers Democrats to vote
* Ensures each new voter has a volunteer sherpa to personally guide them
through the process of voting

Thank you for making it possible!

Beto

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 8/2/2024
body:
Republican campaigns say Colorado GOP turmoil means they are going it alone heading into November
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
ICYMI, yesterday was [Colorado's birthday](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! As you know, the news cycle is busy right now and there's lots happening both nationally and locally here in Colorado. Make sure you're following us on social media to stay up to date in real time!
Follow us: [Facebook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | [X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | [Instagram](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | [Threads](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | [LinkedIn](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | [Truth Social](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | [Gettr](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, August 2, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Ganahl: Trump's Got This](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Conservatives have awakened to a new political landscape, and it's becoming clear that Trump is the leader they need to navigate through it. Kamala Harris, having avoided the rigorous process of a primary, has emerged seemingly unscathed and well-prepared. However, Trump's campaign is far from being blindsided. Instead, they are rallying with a renewed vigor, ready to showcase the stark differences between Harris's radical agenda and Trump's vision for America._
_Harris has closed the gap with Trump in some polls, likely due to the sigh of relief of Democrats after dumping sickly Biden, but this is only the beginning of the battle. Trump's supporters and campaign team are determined not to let this initial surge of Harris's popularity deter them. J.D. Vance hit the nail on the head when he referred to Harris's sudden rise as an "extra-democratic appointment." While it wasn't a coup in the traditional sense, it certainly felt like a strategic maneuver to bypass the democratic process and present a carefully curated candidate who could appeal to a broad audience without undergoing the scrutiny of a primary._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Republican campaigns say Colorado GOP turmoil means they are going it alone heading into November](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Republican campaigns in Colorado are distancing themselves from the state GOP, citing leadership issues and a lack of support following a series of primary losses.
* Colorado GOP Chair Dave Williams faces criticism for misusing funds and being absent, leading to calls for his resignation and further undermining party cohesion.
* As a result, Republican candidates are independently managing campaign activities such as volunteer organization and fundraising, traditionally roles supported by the state party.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Build the wall: Texas wins lawsuit forcing Biden-Harris Admin to continue border wall construction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [TEXAS SCORECARD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Texas has won a significant legal battle against the Biden-Harris administration, mandating the continuation of border wall construction using $1.4 billion in funds that Congress had allocated.
* The lawsuit centered on the administration's attempt to halt the use of these funds for the wall, redirecting them instead to environmental and other border-related projects after President Biden ended the border crisis national emergency declaration in 2021.
* The U.S. District Court in Southern Texas issued a permanent injunction, ensuring that the administration cannot divert the funds, a decision from which the Biden administration has opted not to appeal.
* The legal victory for Texas is seen as a definitive end to this particular dispute over the use of congressionally approved funds for the border wall.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Cats Aren’t Trophies group advances mountain lion hunting ban to ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado voters will decide on Proposition 91 in November, aiming to ban mountain lion, bobcat, and lynx hunting as deemed inhumane and unnecessary.
* Driven by the Cats Aren’t Trophies campaign, the initiative exceeded the required signatures for ballot inclusion, with CPW highlighting hunting's role in population management despite not taking an official stance.
* Opposition from hunting groups argues the ban could disrupt scientific wildlife management and alter the ecosystem, reflecting Colorado's ongoing debate on voter-driven wildlife decisions.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Passage of proposed slaughterhouse ban could cost Denver 2,000 jobs, study finds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMMON SENSE INSTITUTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The proposed Denver slaughterhouse ban could result in a decline of $760 million in total output for the metro Denver area by 2026, even if 80% of the economic activity is retained elsewhere in Colorado.
* Job losses in the metro area could range from 2,160 to 1,930, affecting not just the food processing industry but other sectors as well due to the interconnected nature of local economies.
* The ban could lead to increased emissions due to the need for demolition and construction of new facilities, as well as longer transport routes for goods, contradicting claims of environmental benefits.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[RFK, Jr., qualifies for the Colorado ballot, secretary of state announces](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., and his running mate Nicole Shanahan have secured a spot on the Colorado general election ballot as independent candidates.
* Kennedy, a member of the famous political family, collected a total of 21,702 valid signatures, surpassing the requirement in each of Colorado’s eight congressional districts.
* The campaign gathered the most support in the rural 4th District, with 3,216 valid signatures, and also showed strong backing in the 8th and 2nd Districts.
Election Day for this general election is scheduled for Tuesday, November 5.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Failure by AG, governor and legislature’: Teller County sheriff says safety has been jeopardized](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [MOUNTAIN JACKPOT NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Teller County Sheriff Jason Mikesell publicly criticized Colorado state lawmakers, blaming them for jeopardizing resident safety by opposing the sheriff's office’s 287g agreement with ICE, which the Colorado Court of Appeals recently ruled against.
* The sheriff accused the state of creating "Anti-Teller" laws aimed specifically at hindering the county’s cooperation with ICE, contributing to increased crime rates and asserting that the state has become a "cartel-welcoming" environment.
* Despite recent legal setbacks, County Commissioner Dan Williams expressed continued support for the sheriff, confirming that Teller County will persist in funding the sheriff’s legal battle against the ACLU, emphasizing the county's commitment to maintaining local safety and law enforcement autonomy.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Shapiro: Whiplash-inducing media shift on Kamala Harris is now selling us that she’s the GOAT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_So, Kamala Harris is the new Democratic candidate for president._
_And, we’ve been told, she is incredible._
_Not merely serviceable, a middle innings relief pitcher brought in when your starter suddenly implodes in the third inning. She is the Mariano Rivera of politics. She’s lights-out. She’s charismatic, fascinating, quick on her feet, charming. She is, in the words of the legacy media, a historic candidate—not just because she’s a black woman, a fact that explains her lightning-fast political ascent but that only Democrats are allowed to mention, and only then in the context of explaining why America requires a black female president—but because she is, apparently, so good at this._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[‘I voted’ sticker art contest open to Colorado high school students](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 2** _High school students throughout Colorado are encouraged to participate in a contest being offered by the secretary of state’s office to create an “I Voted” digital sticker._
**[Sloan: With Biden out and Harris in, don’t toll the victory bell just yet](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY KELLY SLOAN | COMMENTARY | JULY 30** []() _In the pantheon of political events, Joe Biden’s belated decision to become the first sitting President since Lyndon B. Johnson to not seek re-election was about as surprising as the advent of the sunrise at dawn._
**_[‘We must protect our kids’: Lundberg calls for ‘all hands on deck’ to help get initiatives to the ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 29** _The final days are winding down in an effort by Protect Kids Colorado to collect the signatures needed to get two initiatives on the fall ballot, former Sen. Kevin Lundberg wrote Monday in an email newsletter._

| | |
# Cornel West for President
---
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fight_for_democracy_continues&n=1)

# The Fight for Democracy Continues.
---
Dear Family, As a supporter of the Cornel West for President campaign, you understand the importance of standing firm in the face of adversity. Recent developments in North Carolina have shown just how vital our campaign is to the political landscape, as the Democratic Party continues its attempt at stifling our progress. During the recent House Oversight and Reform Committee hearings, it was uncovered that the North Carolina Board of Elections was influenced by external pressures from the Democratic Party, leading to serious procedural oversights. These failures directly impacted efforts to secure ballot access for the Justice for All Party - a party that represents truth, justice, and genuine change.
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fight_for_democracy_continues&n=2 "Donate Today") [Donate Today](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fight_for_democracy_continues&n=2)
---
| [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fight_for_democracy_continues&n=3)
---
| Despite allegations from Democratic operatives that 78 of North Carolina's counties failed to verify petition signatures correctly, the state's investigation revealed the reality: **only four counties had issues,** and the Justice for All Party qualifies without the petitions collected in those counties. ****
---
This discrepancy highlights the baseless nature of their claims and exposes the desperate tactics used to undermine us. Our campaign spokesperson, Edwin DeJesus, put it succinctly: “The weakness of these accusations underscores the lack of a substantial case against us. **Their desperation is, in a way, a testament to the strength of our movement.”** This situation is not unique to North Carolina; it is emblematic of a broader strategy employed across the nation. The Democratic National Committee has openly declared its intention to thwart third-party and independent candidates. Fellow American, it's finally come out that what we've known all along is true...

**KAMALA HARRIS, HAKEEM JEFFRIES, AND CHUCK SCHUMER ARE DETERMINED TO WIN THE HOUSE BACK THROUGH NEW YORK!**
New York is truly the apple of the Left's eye. Year after year, they've been successful at winning and holding congressional seats in swing states across the country, and this election cycle, Far Left Radical Hakeem Jeffries has their intentions crystal clear: they firmly believe they can win back the House solely by knocking America First conservatives out of the race.

subject: As we speak
body:
AIPAC has had its eyes set on my fellow Justice Democrats incumbents Cori Bush, Rashida Tlaib, and Ilhan Omar since day one.
#
Peter,
As we speak, AIPAC is targeting the Squad in their Democratic primaries — **the next one is coming up for my friend Rep. Cori Bush on Tuesday, August 6th.**
**[We need the full power of the grassroots to protect our hard-fought progress. Can you rush a donation to Cori’s campaign and Justice Democrats right now to protect the Squad?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240802-2-cb.4Mb_rM&refcode=em20240802-35865&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=2&akid=35865%2E1203867%2EuzgSW-)**

AIPAC has had its eyes set on my fellow Justice Democrats incumbents like Cori Bush and Ilhan Omar since day one — garnering millions in mega donations from Republican millionaires and billionaires to unseat them in their primaries and the general election this upcoming November.
The reason? They’ve all remained boldly outspoken in their call for a ceasefire in Gaza, and they won’t stop speaking out for Palestinian human rights until peace and real justice for Palestinians is our reality.
We know what AIPAC is willing to do to try and tear down our movement. In New York’s 16th District, they spent more money than ever before in a congressional primary race to unseat my friend Jamaal Bowman. They’ve committed to spend $100 million to unseat the Squad and any bold, progressive candidate of color. They’ve blanketed districts with attack ads to spread baseless lies and misinformation. And they think they have us cornered.
**But, our people power is stronger, our collective voice is louder, and together we will win come Election Day.**
We need to be ready to defend the rest of the Squad against any attack from AIPAC or their GOP megadonors. **[Please chip in to Cori’s campaign and Justice Democrats today to support the Squad and ensure they can stay in Congress fighting for us.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240802-2-cb.4Mb_rM&refcode=em20240802-35865&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=22&akid=35865%2E1203867%2EuzgSW-)**
Together,
Pramila Jayapal

clean_body: This July, we faced a number of obstacles in our campaign. | Peter, This July, we faced a number of obstacles in our campaign. From outside groups flooding in money against us to enduring the typical "summer slump" in fundraising, we had a lot to overcome to show everyone that we are a campaign who is in it to win it. But thanks to you, and this team, we not only reached our critical end-of-month goal, we exceeded it – again. Grassroots supporters like you are the backbone of this campaign – and your continued support is what allows us to expand our organizing efforts, place our own ads and stay competitive in this race. But our work is far from over. With less than 100 days until Election Day, every second is make-or-break in a race this close. We have to keep our momentum going if we're going to come out on top on November 5. For now, though, I just want to thank you for all your hard work in keeping PA-08 blue. I'm so proud to serve as your congressman, and so grateful to have a grassroots team as incredible as this supporting me. Thank you, Matt | In 2022, Matt Cartwright was one of only 5 Democrats to win a House race in a district that Donald Trump carried in 2020. name: Travis Tazelaar
subject: The PACT Act is going to decide elections in November.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
If you’ve got a minute, would you let me explain why the PACT Act is going to be so important this year, and what we are going to do to make sure it’s top of mind when Veterans go to the polls in November?
#
Peter, it’s Travis with VoteVets.
By this point you’ve probably heard of the PACT Act. And if you’ve been with VoteVets for a while, you’ve _definitely_ heard of it. If you’ve got a minute, would you let me explain why the PACT Act is going to be so important this year, and what we are going to do to make sure it’s top of mind when Veterans go to the polls in November?
For generations, the men and women who served our country around the world suffered toxic exposures. From Agent Orange in Vietnam to burn pits in Iraq and Afghanistan. And for generations, Veterans went without the care they needed to handle the impacts of those toxic exposures. Many of you are Veterans like me, or you come from Military Families. We know these folks.
Year after year, Congress after Congress, bills went up to provide this care. Year after year, Republicans shot it down. Trump talked a big game — he never got it done. But President Biden’s son was one of the Vets who suffered and died after a toxic exposure. This was a priority for him. It took a coalition led by the President, Democrats, VoteVets, and our allies to get the PACT Act across the finish line last year, and even that came after Republicans in the Senate shot it down and dragged their feet.
It took too long. We lost too many of our brothers and sisters to get here, but we got it done — and that matters. To quote the President, "it’s a Big F’ing Deal". As of today more than a million claims have been filed and granted and more are coming in all the time. The PACT Act was the right thing to do, but I’ll be damned if we don’t make sure that Veterans around the country know that it is Democrats who got this done while Republicans stood in the way.
Starting on August 6th, we’re going to be busing Veterans around the country to talk about the PACT Act. Coast to coast, we’re going to battleground states and districts to support our friends and allies in tough races — the leaders who got this done. The goal is to raise awareness, drive media, and bring Veterans and Military Families on side. We’re going to make some noise here, and we need your help to make sure people hear us.
Big programs like this are not cheap, but VoteVets is one of the only organizations in the country with the infrastructure, the knowledge, and the resources to make it happen. This will make a difference, but we need your help.
So, if this sounds like something you’d be willing to support and you’re ready to help out, I’m humbly asking you:
**[Can you chip in $5 and help us get the wheels rolling on the VoteVets PACT Act Bus Tour? Anything helps here, and every dollar helps us get Veterans around the country to make some noise about this critical legislation and the role Democrats played in getting it done.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-aug24.ccu_CS&refcode=em240802-1-30&t=1&akid=25897%2E3013755%2E-UQSPR)**

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Our movement's values
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
The reality of our movement is that none of us — not me, not Alexandria, not any of us — are able to do this alone.
#
Hi folks, it's Ilhan Omar.
I'm reaching out today to respectfully ask you to [split a contribution — of $5 or anything you can — between my friend Alexandria and my re-election campaign today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240802-ilhan.bC6qAH&refcode=em20240802-6928-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6928%2E2526796%2EfhfEvL)
Here's why:
You probably already know that when I first ran for Congress in 2018, like AOC, I made the decision to reject all donations from special-interest lobbyists and corporate PACs.
At the time, a lot of people saw it as a bold move. But to us, it was barely a decision at all.
My team and I felt that the only way we could build a grassroots, people-powered movement that stuck true to our progressive values was to lead by example.
That started by funding our campaigns the right way — _**together.**_
Since then, hundreds of thousands of supporters have stood by our sides and proven the doubters wrong. Together we've all shown that a mass movement of everyday working people could fund winning campaigns $5, $25, or $50 at a time.
As a result, together — whether in Minnesota or New York — we've taken on millions of dollars in outside super PAC spending, bigoted attacks from the far-right, and have both been top targets for the wealthy and powerful who want to see us fail.
**Time and time again, we've fought back and won.**
Being able to do that this way requires an incredible amount of grassroots support, and a huge portion of our resources come from donations made to emails just like this one. That's true for both me and for Alexandria, and it's why I'm asking you today:
[ Can you split a $5 donation between AOC and I to help power the progressive movement and keep our fight for justice going strong? With just 11 days until primary day in Minnesota, anything you can chip in will go a long way.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240802-ilhan.bC6qAH&refcode=em20240802-6928-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6928%2E2526796%2EfhfEvL)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240802-ilhan.bC6qAH&refcode=em20240802-6928-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6928%2E2526796%2EfhfEvL)**
The reality of our movement is that none of us — not me, not Alexandria, not any of us — are able to do this alone.
Thank you for always having our backs, and for anything you can donate today.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar
**[Contribute](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240802-ilhan.bC6qAH&refcode=em20240802-6928-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=6928%2E2526796%2EfhfEvL)**

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20240802-ilhan?refcode=em20240802-6928-P_FND_SPL_OPP&t=23&refcode2=6928_2526796_fhfEvL&akid=6928%2E2526796%2EfhfEvL)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20240802-6928-P_FND_SPL_OPP&t=24&akid=6928%2E2526796%2EfhfEvL)**
