Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District.
https://ericswalwell.com/ [https://ericswalwell.com/]
Hey there, comedy fans!

Get ready to laugh your socks off because we have a special treat for you! Join us on Monday, August 5, for Comics for Kamala – an evening of engaging conversation and hilarious antics with some of your favorite comedians, and guess what?

It's totally free!

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XM_8Zt3oXqqCn1qdZ-SL0ELEkWVAgRxHdBs3wuP-dKY/viewform?edit_requested=true [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XM_8Zt3oXqqCn1qdZ-SL0ELEkWVAgRxHdBs3wuP-dKY/viewform?edit_requested=true]

It’s not every day you get to hang out with such an incredible lineup. These comedy legends are coming together to support Kamala Harris and her mission for a brighter future. Expect an evening filled with jokes, behind-the-scenes stories, and maybe even some friendly roasting – all in the name of a good cause.

Don’t miss out on this one-of-a-kind event. Click the link below to reserve your spot and get ready for a night of laughs and fun with Eric Swalwell and friends! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XM_8Zt3oXqqCn1qdZ-SL0ELEkWVAgRxHdBs3wuP-dKY/viewform?edit_requested=true]

RSVP » [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XM_8Zt3oXqqCn1qdZ-SL0ELEkWVAgRxHdBs3wuP-dKY/viewform?edit_requested=true]

Let’s show up, support Kamala, and have a blast with these fantastic comedians.

body:
[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/422?t=1001&akid=1314%2E62735%2ESsTu7W ]Hill Harper for Senate

Hey Peter,

We are in the final four-day stretch before the Primary election, and my
team and I are running all over the place in full get-out-the-vote mode,
so I’ll keep this email short and sweet.

Everyday I hear from people - “Man, I can’t wait to vote for you in
November!” and I have to remind them that if we don’t win this Tuesday,
they won’t get to vote for me in November.

That’s why our get-out-the-vote efforts are heavily focused on voter
education. Too many people aren’t aware of the Primary election, and
honestly, it feels like the establishment designs it that way to ensure
that the candidate that is in their pocket secures this Senate seat.

We know that if voter turnout is high, we will win this election. We have
built a broad coalition of underrepresented and often ignored individuals
by the establishment and their chosen candidates. We have the support
needed to win, and we also know that come November, Vice President
Harris’s best chance at winning Michigan is with me on the ballot. Our
campaign will mobilize voters who have been disenfranchised and typically
don’t participate in the electoral process.

In short, we need your help to educate voters in these final four days and
ensure their voices are heard, bringing real representation for the people
in Washington.

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2119?t=1002&akid=1314%2E62735%2ESsTu7W ]Will you please donate today to help us reach as many people as
possible before the polls close on Tuesday?

Hey there, Peter. I just wanted to reach out personally and say thank you for the support you showed Team Busse in July. With your help, we are on our way to accomplishing something incredibly important, but defeating a wealthy incumbent governor like Greg Gianforte is no easy task. He’s got wealthy friends who are happy to help him dismantle the government and sell our state. He’s got a private jet, I have a Chevy truck. He sells our wildlife and stokes culture wars. I meet with people across our state who just want their Montana back. He’s got a huge bank account. We have a movement of people like you. Since day one of our campaign to get our Montana back, you’ve met the moment every single time I needed you, and I can’t thank you enough for that. Every day, I’m out on the road meeting with Montanans and talking about our vision for the future of the Last Best Place. Between what I’m hearing from voters and the support I’ve received from people like you, one thing is clear: **Folks are ready to give Greg Gianforte the boot — and in three months, we’re going to do exactly that.** Thank you for your support this past month, Peter. Every month we meet our fundraising goal is one month closer to winning this thing, and I’m so grateful to have you by my side as we do just that. LFG! Ryan

Friends and Supporters, I’m writing to say thank you. Last night, you placed your trust in me to be the Democratic nominee for US Senate and I am so grateful. First things first, I want to recognize the other Democratic women who ran in this primary election - Marquita Bradshaw, Civil Miller-Watkins, & Lola Denise Brown. What a privilege it was to run against such accomplished and esteemed leaders in our state. I’m very thankful for the work they’ve done to make Tennessee a better place and to fight hard for the values that we all share. I also want to thank all of the Democratic women across the state who ran in - and won - primaries last night for offices across the state. This year, more women than ever have stepped up and taken on the challenge of running for office to make sure we have a government that reflects our values. The program was co-founded by Emerge alums Congresswoman Emilia Sykes (OH-13) and Colorado state Rep. Leslie Herod.

* _**Our 2024 Southern Regional Signature Training cohort graduated in May.**_ Congratulations to our Class of 2024! The Emerge Signature Program is a unique opportunity for Democratic women who want to run for public office across the South. It is the only in-depth training program that inspires candidates to run and gives them the tools to win.

**In case you missed it, JD Vance held his first rally in Virginia since becoming Trump’s vice presidential nominee.**

Vance's visit underscores the importance of standing up for our values and principles. As we kick off August, I want to reach out to say thank you.
Team,

As we kick off August, I want to reach out to say thank you.

Dear Peter,
On July 12, at FreedomFest, I warned if we don’t end our cold civil war, the country would descend into political violence.
The next day, there was an assassination attempt on President Trump.
Thankfully, President Trump survived.
[Sadly, since the shooting, the hateful and unhinged name-calling typical of our broken, political culture has only worsened – on both sides. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_1_nd1&n=5)
Many of us want to get off this collision course. For ourselves, our neighbors and our children.
The reason why this is so critical is because the political assault on the soul of our country that keeps us divided, keeps us distracted from the monumental corruption of our system in plain sight.
In the last election, **the two parties spent over $12 billion dollars** selling off the seats of power in Washington to the highest bidder.
This peak corruption has left us with a government and an economy rigged to exploit the many and build the outsized wealth of a few.
As a result, the top 1% now owns more wealth than the 60% in the middle, our entire middle class. And hard working Americans can no longer afford life in America.
This perversion distorts and inverts our national priorities, casts aside the people’s interest and has led to decades of war, chronic disease and a devastated middle class.
[If you elect me President, I will end the forever wars and cut our wasteful defense spending in half which will still leave us with an annual defense budget that far outstrips Russia and China’s combined. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_1_nd1&n=6)
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_1_nd1&n=7)
---
To rebuild our Middle Class and your power in our democracy, we will reinvest the trillions saved in our Main Street economy, small business, our infrastructure and struggling communities.
This will create millions of new jobs annually and stoke an economic boom. Our tax base will expand. We’ll pay down the debt and restore fiscal sanity.
Life in America can and will be affordable again if you help elect me President.
Over the last 40 years while party politicians have been cozying up to big money, I’ve spent those decades fighting the corporate contamination of our environment and corruption of our system.
[Send me to Washington and I will clean house.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_1_nd1&n=8)
This election is not about left vs right. It’s about all Americans of good will coming together to end the tyranny of corruption in our system so we can build back America, strong.
**We’ve given the Democrats a chance to fix this country. We’ve given Republicans a chance.** What has not had a chance is a unity government, headed by an independent President beholden to no party, free from corporate influence, owing no favors to the Washington establishment, and ready to recruit the best ideas from all those who have been left out.
[It’s long past time we put people before politics and country before party.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_1_nd1&n=9)

Life in America can and will be affordable again if you help elect me President. Over the last 40 years while party politicians have been cozying up to big money, I’ve spent those decades fighting the corporate contamination of our environment and corruption of our system. This election is not about left vs right. It’s about all Americans of good will coming together to end the tyranny of corruption in our system so we can build back America, strong. We’ve given the Democrats a chance to fix this country. We’ve given Republicans a chance. What has not had a chance is a unity government, headed by an independent President beholden to no party, free from corporate influence, owing no favors to the Washington establishment, and ready to recruit the best ideas from all those who have been left out. | | | Sincerely, Robert F. body:
Ordinarily, I don’t like to pair an ask with a thank you.

| | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90112263/489457249/-1050334400?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTIyNTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmVjYmI2ODktMjE1MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7asclsS1-Erji-o1IOxBptzGBEj2aCnkQoZDf0NpaiQ=)
---
Hi there,

First, I want to personally thank you for the support you showed our campaign in July. From our opponent putting ads on TV to a change the in presumptive Democratic nominee for President, it was an action packed month, and I’m grateful to be in this fight with you.

Friend- I'm black, not braindead.

But the liberal media still said I was off my rocker for thinking I had a place in the party of Donald J. Trump.

They said there was no way the America First movement would ever consider supporting me.

They said the same thing in 2020 when I was running to become the first black Lt. Governor of North Carolina, and sure enough they were wrong.

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
August 2, 2024

Contact: Press@KevinFaulconer.com
**Former Mayor Faulconer’s Campaign for County Supervisor Surpasses Incumbent TerraLawson-Remer in Fundraising and Cash on Hand**
SAN DIEGO, CA – Kevin Faulconer’s campaign for San Diego County Supervisor announced that it has outraised incumbent Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer and has more cash on hand for the consecutive second quarter, placing his campaign in the driver’s seat ahead of the November election. This underscores the growing momentum behind Faulconer, whose campaign has received endorsements from all sides of the political aisle. The former two-term mayor is best positioned to successfully address the escalating homelessness crisis that has worsened under Lawson-Remer's tenure.
**“People across our community want a new voice. They want change. They want a supervisor who will show up to work and face issues head-on,” said former Mayor Faulconer. “I have the experience, dedication, and vision to address the homelessness crisis effectively just as I did while I was Mayor of San Diego, where homelessness went down by double digits, while it increased in other major cities.”**
The surge in campaign contributions and the substantial cash on hand reflect the public's desire for effective leadership and a commitment to solving critical issues like homelessness. With this strong financial position, the Faulconer’s campaign is poised to bring about much-needed change at the County level. To date, Faulconer’s campaign has raised over $800,000.
Faulconer served as the mayor of San Diego from 2014 to 2020. During his tenure, he reduced homelessness by double digits, improved public safety making San Diego the safest big city in the country, and enhance the quality of life for all residents. Faulconer is committed to bringing his proven leadership and experience to the Board of Supervisors.###

body:
We've known from the very beginning that right-wing PACs and their billionaire donors were watching our campaign closely. And today's the day we need to fight back directly.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1273%2E791427%2ELyNk7T)

We know it's getting late on a Friday, but we had to make sure you saw this:
**The same group who came after us in 2022 — using AIPAC's money from Republican billionaires — just filed a $30,000 expenditure with the FEC for attack mailers against Ilhan, only 11 days out from our primary here in Minnesota.**
We've known from the very beginning that right-wing super PACs and their billionaire donors were watching our campaign closely. And today's the day we need to fight back directly.
Now, our campaign's average donation this quarter is just $19.88. Ilhan's very proud of that fact, and we hope you are too.
**But it does mean that for every $30,000 in outside cash poured into our district, we need 1,509 grassroots contributions just to keep up.**
That's why we're hoping we can count on you today:
**[Can you rush your first contribution — of $3 or any amount — to stand with Ilhan, especially today? Taking on the super PACs and their outside money to win this race is something we can only do if we're in this fight together.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug24.QjfTG2&refcode=em240802&t=2&akid=1273%2E791427%2ELyNk7T)**
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug24.QjfTG2&refcode=em240802&t=3&akid=1273%2E791427%2ELyNk7T)
With 11 days to go in this primary, it's clear that our fight isn't over yet.
This same group spent over _half a million dollars_ in support of our opponent last cycle, so we need to keep the pace and then some _every day_ if we're going to finish the job and send Ilhan back to Congress.
Thanks for being with us. More soon.
In solidarity,
Team Ilhan

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90113301/489460845/1174061679?refcode=header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTY3Zjc3ZDUtMjU1MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XQGTKcd4SlvXhCe_Te09OpwO9StYGi3HrelZLLZWOTo=) | Peter, Throughout this entire election, I’ve faced microaggressions and macroaggressions from the media and my opponents. The attacks just don't stop coming, and I am sick and tired of the slander and disrespect. I knew that our pro-peace, people-powered movement would rile up many feathers, but this constant barrage of attacks shows that our momentum is making waves. They’re trying to dismantle what we’ve built. Our fundamental rights are on the ballot this election cycle, and the critics we’ve encountered don’t want to see a Michigan that supports a ceasefire in Gaza, affordable and quality healthcare for all, economic dignity and opportunity for everyone, or increased investment in public health, education, and our children’s futures. **[Contributing just $10 right now could be the deciding factor in whether Michigan stands on the right side of history or falls prey to the status quo.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90113302/489460846/-1272854636?refcode=080224CeaseandDesistFR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTY3Zjc3ZDUtMjU1MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XQGTKcd4SlvXhCe_Te09OpwO9StYGi3HrelZLLZWOTo=)** [**We are only $15,000 away from hitting our goal of $20,000, which means we can pay all our canvassers that have been working in overdrive trying to get to every last voter**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90113303/489460847/-1272854636?refcode=080224CeaseandDesistFR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTY3Zjc3ZDUtMjU1MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XQGTKcd4SlvXhCe_Te09OpwO9StYGi3HrelZLLZWOTo=). As the only Black woman in this race and the sole advocate for progressive values—like calling for an immediate and permanent ceasefire—I’ve made no friends in the process. But seeing a comment that I’m running a campaign with criminals left me speechless. Labeling my late colleague, and by extension me, as criminals is a level of disrespect I haven’t seen directed at any of my opponents this cycle. It’s deeply hurtful and jarring that the only Black scientist candidate in this competitive district is being subjected to such treatment. Yet, I remain committed to standing up for what I believe in, and I believe in Michigan. These attacks only prove that we have the potential to bring real change to Michigan. They're more interested in passing another round of Trump handouts to billionaires and big corporations if they take control of the Senate next year. You read that right. My bipartisan bill would have helped 16 million kids get ahead, invest in research and development for businesses, turn off a firehose of taxpayer-funded fraud, and build 200,000 new affordable housing units. Back in 2021, Democrats expanded the child tax credit, and it was an overwhelming success. Child poverty was cut in half. For the first time in their lives, millions of families were no longer having to make tough choices about paying rent and buying groceries. After it expired, my bipartisan bill has been stuck in political infighting and gridlock among Senate Republican leadership. Republicans talk a big game about being "pro-family."
